a: Kashya.
Ibbaya lehu: huddechu mealehen, mahu? "vayyaddichu" amar rachamana, velo shehuddechu mealehen? o dilma, afillu huddechu mealehen?
Ta shema: hiddichuha nashim uketannim, ammay? leheve kehuddechu mealehen! hanach batar nafshayyhu geridi, hane batar nashim uketannim geridi.
Ad sheyyudach rubbah. hechi avdinan? amar rav yehuda: danin vechovshin, danin vechovshin. amar leh ulla: nimtza atta meanne et dinan shel ellu! ella, amar ulla: danin vesoklin, danin vesoklin.
Ittemar, rabbi yochanan amar: danin vesoklin, danin vesoklin, veresh lakish amar: marbin lahen batte dinin.

Ini? vehaamar rabbi chama bar yose amar rabbi oshaya: "vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi" – ish veishsha atta motzi lisharecha, vei atta motzi kol hair kullah lisharecha! ella, marbin lahen batte dinin umeayyeynin bedinehen, umassekinan lehu levet din haggadol, vegamri lehu ledinayyhu, vekatli lehu.

"Hakke takke et yoshve hair vechulei". tanu rabbanan: hachammeret vehaggammelet haoveret mimmakom lemakom, lanu betochah vehuddechu immah – im nishtahu sham sheloshim yom, hen besayif umamonan aved. pachot mikkan, hen biskila umamonan palet.
Ureminhi: kamma yihye bair veyihye keanshe hair? shenem asar chodesh! amar rava: la kashya, ha lemihve mibbene mata, ha lemihve miyyatve mata.

Vehatanya: hammuddar hanaa mibbene hair, im yesh adam shennishtaha sham shenem asar chodesh – asur lehanot mimmennu, pachot mikkan – muttar lehanot mimmennu. beyoshve hair, im nishtaha sheloshim yom – asur lehanot mimmennu, pachot mikkan – muttar lehanot mimmennu.

"Hacharem otah veet kol asher bah" kulei. tanu rabbanan: "hacharem otah veet kol asher bah" – perat lenichse tzaddikim shebbechutza lah. "veet kol asher bah" – lerabbot nichse tzaddikim shebbetochah. "shelalah" – velo shelal shamayim. "veet kol shelalah" – lerabbot nichse reshaim shechutza lah.

Amar rabbi shimon: mippene ma amra tora nichse tzaddikim shebbetochah yovedu? mi garam lahem sheyyaduru betochah? mamonam. lefichach mamonam aved. amar mar: "veet kol shelalah tikbotz" – lerabbot nichse reshaim shebbechutza lah. amar rav chisda: uvenikbatzim letochah.

Amar rav chisda: pikdonot shel anshe ir hanniddachat muttarin. hechi dame? i lema deir acheret veitanhu begavva – peshita demuttarin, lav shelalah hu! veella didhu veitanhu beir acheret. i denikbatzin letochah – ammay muttarin? vei en nikbatzin letochah – ha amra chada zimna!
La, leolam deir acheret demafkedi betochah. vehacha bemay askinan? kegon dekabbel aleh achrayut. mahu detema: kevan dekabbel aleh achrayut, kedideh dame? ka mashma lan.

Amar rav chisda: behema chetzyah shel ir hanniddachat vechetzyah shel ir acheret – asura. issa chetzyah shel ir hanniddachat vechetzyah shel ir acheret – mutteret. may tama? behema keman dela peliga damya, issa keman difliga damya.

Bae rav chisda: behemat ir hanniddachat mahu detithane ba shechita letaharah mide nevela? lefi cherev amar rachamana, la shena shachata mishchat, la shena katla miktal. o dilma, kevan deshachta mahneya la shechita? may? teku.
Bae rav yosef: sear nashim tzidkaniyyot mahu? amar rava: ha dirshaiyyot asur? "tikbotz vesarafta" ketiv. mi sheeno mechussar ella kevitza userefa – yatza ze shemchussar telisha ukevitza userefa.

Ella amar rava: befea nochrit, hechi dame? i dimchubbar begufa, kegufa damya. la tzericha ditle besivta. kenichse tzaddikim shebbetochah dame veavad? o dilma, kevan deayyla venafka, kilvusha dame? teku.

"Veet kol shelalah tikbotz el toch rechovah" vechulei. tanu rabbanan: en lah rechov – enah naaset ir hanniddachat, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: en lah rechov – osin lah rechov. bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: "rechovah" – meikkara mashma, umar savar: "rechovah" – hasheta name mashma.
b: Vehahekdeshot shebbah yippadu kulei. tanu rabbanan: hayu bah kodshe kodashim, kodshe mizbeach – yamutu, kodshe bedek habbayit – yippadu, uterumot – yerakvu, umaaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh – yigganzu. rabbi shimon omer: "behemtah" – velo behemat bechor umaaser, "shelalah" – perat lechesef hekdesh vechesef maaser.
Amar mar: hayu bah kodshe kodashim, kodshe mizbeach – yamutu. veammay yamutu? yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyippelu demehen lindava.
Rabbi yochanan amar: "zevach reshaim toeva". resh lakish amar: mamon bealim hu. vehacha bekadashim shechayyayv beachrayutan, verabbi shimon hi deamar: mamon bealim hu.
Ha middesefa rabbi shimon hi, resha lav rabbi shimon? bekadashim kallim, veallibba derabbi yose haggelili deamar: kadashim kallim mamon bealim. aval kodshe kadashim may? yippadu.

Addetane sefa: kodshe bedek habbayit yippadu, liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim? bekadashim kallim, aval kodshe kadashim – yippadu. kevan deikka chattat shemmetu bealeha, dilmita azla, la pesika leh.

Bishlama rabbi yochanan la amar keresh lakish, dichtiv: "zevach reshaim toeva". ella resh lakish, may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan? amar lach: ki amrinan "zevach reshaim toeva", hane mille hecha deitanhu beenayyhu, aval hacha, kevan deishtanni – ishtanni.
Rabbi shimon omer: "behemtah" – velo behemat bechor umaaser. bemay askinan? ilema bitmimin – shelal shamayim hu! ella bevaale mumin – shelalah ninhu?
Amar ravina: leolam bevaale mumin, umi shenneechol betorat behemtah. yatzu ellu sheen neechalin betorat behemtah, ella betorat bechor umaaser, dishlal shamayim ninhu.

Ufeliga dishmuel, deamar shemuel: hakkol karev vehakkol nifde. may kaamar? hachi kaamar: kol shekkarev keshehu tam, venifde keshehu baal mum – mishshelalah" immeit, vechol shekkarev keshehu tam veeno nifda keshehu baal mum, kegon bechor umaaser – mibbehemtah" nafka.
Terumot yerakvu. amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella teruma beyad yisrael, aval teruma beyad kohen, kevan demamoneh hu, tissaref.

Metiv rav yosef: maaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh yigganzu. veha maaser sheni beyad yisrael kitruma beyad kohen dame, vekatane yigganzu! ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rav chisda, lo shanu ella teruma beyad kohen, aval teruma beyad yisrael tinnaten lechohen shebbeir acheret.

Tenan hatam: issa shel maaser sheni petura min hachalla, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim mechayyeyvin. amar rav chisda: machloket bemaaser sheni birushalayim, derabbi meir savar maaser sheni mamon gavoah hu, verabbanan savri mamon hedyot hu. aval bigvulin, divre hakkol patur.

Metiv rav yosef: maaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh yigganzu. bemay askinan? ilema birushalayim, mi havya ir hanniddachat? vehatanya: asara devarim neemru birushalayim, vezo achat mehen – enah naaset ir hanniddachat! veella beir acheret, veasseku legavva? ha kaltu mechitzot!
Ella lav bigvulin, vekatane: yigganzu? la, leolam deir acheret, veasseku legavva. vehacha bemay askinan? shennitma.

Velifrekeh? deamar rabbi elazar: minnayin lemaaser sheni shennitma sheppodin oto afillu birushalayim? talmud lomar: "lo tuchal seeto", veen seet ella achila, shenneemar: "vayyissa masot meet panav". hacha bemay askinan? belakuach.

a: Velifrekeh, ditnan: hallakuach bechesef maaser shennitma – yippade. kerabbi yehuda, deamar: yikkaver. i hachi, may irya ir hanniddachat? afillu dealma name!
Ella leolam betahor, uchegon dinful mechitzot, vechidrava deamar rava: mechitza leechol – deorayyta, liklot – derabbanan. vechi gezur rabbanan ki itanhu limchitzot, ki letanhu limchitzot – la.

Kitve hakkodesh yigganzu. matnitin dela kerabbi eliezer, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer, kol ir sheyyesh bah afillu mezuza achat enah naaset ir hanniddachat, shenneemar: "vesarafta vaesh et hair veet kol shelalah kalil". vehecha deikka mezuza la efshar, dichtiv: "lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem".

Rabbi shimon omer: amar hakkadosh baruch hu vechulei. lema bidrabbi avin amar rabbi ila kamippalgi? deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila: kol makom sheatta motze kelal baase uferat belo taase, en danin oto bichlal uferat.
Demar it leh derabbi avin, umar let leh derabbi avin.
La, dechulle alma it lehu derabbi avin, vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar "od" ligmare mashma, umar savar "od" – lichma shehayta enah nivnet, aval naaset hi gannot ufardesim.

Tanu rabbanan: hayu bah ilanot telushin – asurin, mechubbarin – muttarin. shel ir acheret, ben telushin ben mechubbarin – asurin. may "ir acheret"? amar rav chisda: yericho, dichtiv: "vehayta hair cherem laAdonai... vayyashba yehoshua baet hahi lemor arur haish lifne Adonai asher yakum uvana et hair hazzot et yericho bivchoro yeyassedenna uvitziro yatztziv delateha".
Tanya: lo yericho al shem ir acheret, velo ir acheret al shem yericho, dichtiv: "bana chiel bet haeli et yericho baaviram bechoro yissedah uvisguv tzeiro hitztziv delateha".
Tanya: baaviram bechoro, rasha, lo haya lo lilmod. bisguv tzeiro, haya lo lilmod.

Aviram useguv may avud? may kaamar? hachi kaamar: baaviram bechoro haya lo lilmod leoto rasha, bisguv tzeiro. mimmashma shenneemar "baaviram bechoro" eni yodea shesseguv tzeiro? ma talmud lomar "seguv tzeiro"? melammed shehaya mekabber veholech meaviram ad seguv.

Achav shoshvineh hava. ata ihu veeliyyahu lemishal bishlama be tamya. yatev vekaamar: dilma ki lat yehoshua hachi lat – lo yericho al shem ir acheret, velo ir acheret al shem yericho? amar leh eliyyahu: in. amar leh: hasheta levavtta demoshe la ka mikkayyma, dichtiv "vesartem vaavadtem vegomer" uchetiv "vechara af Adonai bachem veatzar et hashshamayim vegomer", vehahu gavra okem leh avoda zara al kol telem vetelem vela shavek leh mitra lemezal misgad leh. levavtta dihoshua talmideh mikkayyma?
Miyyad: "vayyomer eliyyahu hattishbi mittoshave gilad chay Adonai elohe yisrael im yihye tal umatar vegomer". bae rachame, vihavu leh aklida demitra, vekam vaazal.

"Vayhi devar Adonai elav lemor. lech mizze ufanita lecha kedma venistarta benachal kerit". "vehaorvim meviim lo lechem uvasar babboker vegomer". mehecha? amar rav yehuda amar rav: mibbe tabbache deachav. "vayhi mikketz yamim vayyivash hannachal ki lo haya geshem baaretz". kevan dachaza deikka tzaara bealma, ketiv: "vayhi devar Adonai elav lemor. kum lech tzarfata".

Uchetiv: "vayhi achar haddevarim haelle chala ben haishsha baalat habbayit". bea rachame lemittan leh aklida ditchiyyayt hammetim. amri leh: shalosh maftechot lo nimseru leshaliach: shel chayya, veshel geshamim, veshel techiyyayt hammetim. yomru: shetayim beyad talmid veachat beyad harav! ayyti ha ushekel hay. dichtiv: "lech herae el achav veettena matar".
Derash hahu galilaa kammeh derav chisda: mashal deeliyyahu, lamma haddavar dome? legavra detarkeh legalleh veabbedeh lemaftecheh.
Daresh rabbi yose betzippori: abba eliyyahu
b: Kappedan hava. regil lemete gabbeh. ikkassi minneh telata yome, vela ata. ki ata, amar leh: ammay la ata mar? amar leh: kappedan karet li! amar leh: ha dekamman, deka kafed mar!
"Velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem" – kol zeman shershaim baolam, charon af baolam vechulei. man reshaim? amar rav yosef: gannave.

Tanu rabbanan: rasha ba laolam – charon ba leolam, shenneemar: "bevo rasha ba gam buz veim kalon cherpa". rasha aved min haolam – tova baa leolam, shenneemar: "uvaavod reshaim rinna". tzaddik niftar min haolam – raa baa leolam, shenneemar: "hatztzaddik avad veen ish sam al lev veanshe chesed neesafim been mevin ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik". tzaddik ba laolam – tova baa leolam, shenneemar: "ze yenachamenu mimmaasenu umeitztzevon yadenu".
Hadaran alach kol yisrael yesh lahem chelek uselika la massechet sanhedrin

a: Mishna ketzad haedim naasim zommin? "meidin anu beish peloni shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza", en omrim: yease ze ben gerusha o ben chalutza tachtav, ella loke arbaim.
"Meidin anu beish peloni shehu chayyayv liglot", en omrim: yigle ze tachtav, ella loke arbaim.

Gemara ha "ketzad en haedim naasim zommin" mibbee leh! veod, middekatane lekamman: aval amru lahem: "heach attem meidin, hare beoto hayyom attem heyitem immanu bemakom peloni" – hare ellu zommin, mikkelal deellu en zommin!
Tanna hatam kae: kol hazzommin makdimin leotah mita, chutz mizzomme bat kohen uvoalah, sheen makdimin leotah mita ella lemita acheret.

Veyesh edim zommin acherim, sheen osin bahen din hazama kol ikkar, ella malkot arbaim, ketzad? "meidin anu beish peloni shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza", en omrim: yease ze ben gerusha o ben chalutza tachtav, ella loke et haarbaim.

Menahane mille? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: deamar kera: "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam", "lo" – velo lezaro. velifseluhu ledideh vela lifselu lezareh! bainan "kaasher zamam laasot", velekka.
Bar peda omer: kal vachomer, uma hamechallel eno mitchallel, habba lechallel velo chillel – eno din shello yitchallel? matkef la ravina: im ken bittalta torat edim zommin!
b: Uma hassokel eno niskal, habba liskol velo sakal – eno din shello yissakel? ella mechavvavrta kidshanninan meikkara.
Meidin anu beish peloni shehu chayyayv galut kulei. mena hane mille? amar resh lakish: deamar kera: "hu yanus el achat hearim" – hu, vela zommin.
Rabbi yochanan omer: kal vachomer: uma hu, sheasa maase – bemezid eno gole, hen, shello asu maase – bemezid eno din shello yiglu?

Vehi notenet, (vahalo din hu): hu, sheasa maase – bemezid la ligle, ki hechi dela tehve leh kappara. hen, shello asu maase – bemezid name liglo, ki hechi delehve lehu kappara! ella mechavvavrta kidresh lakish.

Amar ulla: remez leedim zommin min hattora minnayin? remez leedim zommin?! veha ketiv: "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam"! ella: remez leedim zommin shellokin min hattora, minnayin? dichtiv: "vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik vehirshiu et harasha. vehaya im bin hakkot harasha". mishshum vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik – vehirshiu et harasha, vehaya im bin hakkot harasha?
Ella: edim shehirshiu et hatztzaddik, vaato edim acharine vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik demeikkara, veshavvinhu lehane reshaim, "vehaya im bin hakkot harasha".
Vetippok leh millo taane"! mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav.

Tanu rabbanan: arbaa devarim neemru beedim zommin: en naasin ben gerusha uven chalutza, veen golin leare miklat, veen meshallemin et hakkofer, veen nimkarin beeved ivri. mishshum rabbi akiva amru: af en meshallemin al pi atzman.
En naasin ben gerusha uven chalutza – kedaamaran. veen golin leare miklat – kedaamaran. veen meshallemin et hakkofer – kasavri: kufera – kappara, vehane lav bene kappara ninhu.

Man tana kufera kappara? amar rav chisda: rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi, detanya: "venatan pidyon nafsho" – deme nizzak. rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: deme mazzik. may lav beha ka mippalgi? demar savar: kufera mamona, umar savar: kufera kappara?
Amar rav pappa: la, dechulle alma kufera kappara, vehacha beha ka mippalgi, mar savar: bidnizzak shayyminan, umar savar: bidmazzik shayyminan.
May tamayyhu derabbanan? neemar hashata lematta, veneemar hashata lemala. ma lehallan – bidnizzak, af kan – bidnizzak.
Verabbi yishmael: "venatan pidyon nafsho" ketiv. verabbanan? en, "pidyon nafsho" ketiv, mihu ki shayyminan, bidnizzak shayyminan.

Veen nimkarin beeved ivri. savar rav hamenuna lememar: hane mille hecha deit leh ledideh, demiggo deihu la nizdabban – inhu name la mizdabbenu. aval hecha delet leh ledideh, af al gav deit lehu ledidhu – mizdabbenu.

Amar leh rava: velemru leh: i ant hava lach mi hava mizdabbenat? anan name la mizdabbeninan. ella savar rav hamenuna lememar: hane mille hecha deit leh o ledideh o ledidhu, aval hecha delet leh la ledideh vela ledidhu – mizdabbeni. amar leh rava: "venimkar bignevato", amar rachamana – bignevato, velo bizmamo.

Mishshum rabbi akiva amru vechulei. may tama derabbi akiva? kasavar kenasa hu, ukenas en meshallem al pi atzmo. amar rabba: teda, shehare lo asu maase, [veneheragim] umeshallemin. amar rav nachman: teda, shehare mamon beyad bealim, umeshallemim.

a: May nihu, delo asu maase? hayeynu derabba! ema: "vechen amar rav nachman".
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: ed zomem meshallem lefi chelko. may "meshallem lefi chelko"? illema dehay meshallem palga vehay meshallem palga, tenena: meshalleshin bemamon, veen meshalleshin bemalkot!
Ella: kegon deittazzum chad minnayyhu, dimshallem palga dideh, umi meshallem? veha tanya: en ed zomem meshallem mamon ad sheyyizzommu shenehem!
Amar rava: beomer "edut sheker headti". kol keminneh? kevan shehiggid shuv eno chozer umaggid!
Ella beomer: "headnu vehuzamnu bevet din peloni". keman – dela kerabbi akiva, dei kerabbi akiva, ha amar: af eno meshallem al pi atzmo!
Ella beomer "headnu vehuzamnu bevet din peloni vechuyyayvnu mamon".
Salka datach amena: kevan dilchavreh la matze mechayyev leh, ihu name la michayyayv, ka mashma lan.
Mishna "meidin anu et ish peloni sheggerash et ishto velo natan lah ketuvatah", vahalo ben hayyom uven lemachar, sofo litten lah ketuvatah.
Omdin kamma adam rotze litten bichtubbatah shel zo, sheim nitalmena o nitgarsha, veim meta, yirashenna baalah.
Gemara ketzad shamin? amar rav chisda: babbaal.
Rav natan bar oshaya omer: baishsha.
Amar rav pappa: baishsha uvichtubbatah.
Mishna "meidin anu beish peloni shehu chayyayv lachavero elef zuz, al menat littenan lo mikkan vead sheloshim yom", vehu omer, "mikkan vead eser shanim".
Omdim kamma adam rotze litten veyihyu beyado elef zuz, ben notnan mikkan vead sheloshim yom, ben notnan mikkan vead eser shanim.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hammalve et chavero leeser shanim – sheviit meshammatto.
b: Veaf al gav dehashta la karenan beh "lo yiggos", sof ate lide "lo yiggos".

Metiv rav kahana: omdim kamma adam rotze litten veyihyu elef zuz beyado ben litten mikkan vead sheloshim yom, uven litten mikkan vead eser shanim. vei amrat sheviit meshammatto – kullehu name bae shallome leh!
Amar rava: hacha bemay askinan – bemalve al hammashkon, uvemoser shetarotav levet din. ditnan: hammalve al hammashkon, vehammoser shetarotav levet din – en mashmitin.
Ikka deamri, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hammalve et chavero leeser shanim – en sheviit meshammatto. veaf al gav deate lide "lo yiggos", hasheta miha la karenan beh "lo yiggos".

Amar rav kahana: af anan name tenena: omdin kamma adam rotze litten veyihyu elef zuz beyado, ben litten mikkan vead sheloshim yom, uven litten mikkan vead eser shanim. vei amrat sheviit meshammatto – kullehu name bau shallome leh.
Amar rava: hacha bemay askinan – bemalve al hammashkon, uvemoser shetarotav levet din, ditnan: hammalve al hammashkon, vehammoser shetarotav levet din – en mashmitin.

Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: haomer lachavero "al menat shello teshammeteni sheviit" – sheviit meshammetet. lema kasavar shemuel: matne al ma shekkatuv battora hu, vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora – tenao batel?
Veha ittemar, haomer lachavero: "al menat sheen lecha alay onaa", rav omer: yesh lo alav onaa, ushemuel omer: en lo alav onaa.
Ha ittemar ala, amar rav anan: ledidi mipparsha leh minneh dishmuel, "al menat sheen lecha alay onaa" – en lo alav onaa. "al menat sheen bo onaa" – hare yesh bo onaa.
Hacha name, "al menat shello teshammeteni bashsheviit" – en sheviit meshammatto. "al menat shello teshammeteni sheviit" – sheviit meshammatto.

Tana: hammalve et chavero setam – eno rashshay letovo pachot mishsheloshim yom. sevar rabba bar bar channa kammeh derav lememar: hane mille bemilve bishtar, dela avid inish detarach dechatev shetar betzir mittelatin yomin, aval milve al pe – la. amar leh rav: hachi amar chavivi: echad hammalve bishtar veechad hammalve al pe.
Tanya name hachi: hammalve et chavero setam – eno rashshay letovo pachot mishsheloshim yom, echad hammalve bishtar veechad hammalve al pe.

Amar leh shemuel lerav matna: la tittev akkaraycha ad dimfarshat lah leha shemata: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan: hammalve et chavero setam eno rashshay letovo pachot mishsheloshim yom, echad hammalve bishtar veechad hammalve al pe?

Amar leh: dichtiv "karva shenat hashsheva shenat hashshemitta", mimmashma shenneemar "karva shenat hashsheva", eni yodea shehi shenat shemitta? ella ma talmud lomar "shenat hashshemitta"? lomar lach: [yesh] shemitta acheret shehi kazo, veezo – zo hammalve et chavero setam, sheeno rashshay letovo befachot mishsheloshim yom. deamar mar: sheloshim yom bashshana chashuv shana.
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: happoteach bet hatztzavvar beshabbat – chayyayv chattat. matkef lah rav kahana: vechi ma ben ze limgufat chavit? amar leh: ze chibbur, veze eno chibbur.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: sheloshet luggin mayim shennafal letochan kuretov shel yayin, umarehen kemare yayin, venaflu lemikve – lo pesaluhu. matkef lah rav kahana: vechi ma ben ze leme tzeva? ditnan: rabbi yose omer: me tzeva poslin et hammikve bishloshet luggin. amar leh rava: hatam "mayya detziva" mikkere, hacha "chamra meziga" mikkere.
Vehatane rabbi chiyyay: horidu et hammikve! amar rava: la kashya, ha rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ha rabbanan, ditnan: sheloshet luggin mayim

a: Chaser kuretov, shennafal letochan kuretov yayin, umarehen kemare yayin, venaflu lammikve – lo pesaluhu. vechen shelosha luggin mayim chaser kuretov, shennafal letochan kuretov chalav, umarehen kemare mayim, venaflu lammikve – lo pesaluhu.
Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: hakkol holech achar hammare.

Ha mibbaya bae la rav pappa. devae rav pappa: rav tane: "chaser kuretov" beresha, aval shelosha luggin, letanna kamma pasli, vaata rabbi yochanan lememar: hakkol holech achar hammare, verav omer kerabbi yochanan ben nuri.
O dilma rav la tane: "chaser kuretov" beresha, verabbi yochanan ben nuri – ki pelig, assefa hu diflig,
Verav deamar – kedivre hakkol?
Lerav pappa mibbaya leh, lerava peshita leh.

Amar rav yosef: la shemia li ha shemata. amar leh abbaye: at amart la nihalan, vehachi amart nihalan, derav la tane "chaser kuretov" beresha, verabbi yochanan assefa pelig, verav deamar kedivre hakkol.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: chavit melea mayim shennafla layyam haggadol, hattovel sham – lo alta lo tevila. chayyshinan lishlosha luggin shello yehu bemakom echad. vedavka layyam haggadol, dekae vekayyma, aval nahara bealma – la.

Tanya name hachi: chavit melea yayin shennafla layyam haggadol, hattovel sham – lo alta lo tevila. chayyshinan lishlosha luggin sheuvin shello yehu bemakom echad. vechen kikkar shel teruma shennafal sham – tame.
May "vechen"? mahu detema, hatam oke gavra achezkeh, hacha oke teruma achezka, ka mashma lan.

Mishna "meidin anu beish peloni shechayyayv lachavero matayim zuz", venimtzeu zommin – lokin umeshallemin, shello hashshem hammevian lide makkot mevian lide tashlumin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: kol hameshallem – eno loka.

"Meidin anu beish peloni shehu chayyayv malkot arbaim", venimtzeu zommin – lokin shemonim, mishshum: "lo taane vereacha ed shaker", umishshum: "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam", divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: en lokin ella arbaim.
b: Gemara bishlama lerabbanan. "kede rishato" ketiv, mishshum risha achat atta mechayyeyvo vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum shete rishayot. ella rabbi meir may tama?
Amar ulla: gamar mimmotzi shem ra. ma motzi shem ra – loke umeshallem, af kol – loke umeshallem. ma lemotzi shem ra, shekken kenas! savar la kerabbi akiva, deamar: edim zommin – kenasa hu.
Ikka dematne leha deulla aha detanya: "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vehannotar mimmennu ad boker, vegomer" – ba hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase, lomar sheen lokin alav, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi akiva omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav. mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar lav sheen bo maase lokin alav, mena leh?
Amar ulla: gamar mimmotzi shem ra. ma motzi shem ra lav sheen bo maase – lokin alav, af kol lav sheen bo maase – lokin alav. ma lemotzi shem ra, shekken loke umeshallem!
Ella amar resh lakish: gamar meedim zommin. ma edim zommin lav sheen bo maase – lokin alav, af kol lav sheen bo maase – lokin alav. ma leedim zommin, shekken en tzerichin hateraa!
Motzi shem ra yochiach. vechazar haddin: lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – lav sheen bo maase velokin alav, af kol lav sheen bo maase lokin alav.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken kenas! ha la kashya: rabbi yehuda la savar la kerabbi akiva.
Ella: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken yesh bahen tzad chamur! verabbi yehuda? tzad chamur la parech.
Verabbanan, hay "lo taane vereacha ed shaker" may darshi beh?
Hahu mibbee leh leazhara leedim zommin. verabbi meir, azhara leedim zommin mena leh? amar rabbi yirmeya: nafka leh mivvehannisharim yishmeu veyirau velo yosifu od".
Verabbanan? hahu mibbee leh

a: Lehacheraza. verabbi meir? hacheraza miyyishmeu veyirau" nafka.

Mishna meshalleshin bammamon veen meshalleshin bammakkot. ketzad? heiduhu shehu chayyayv lachavero matayim zuz venimtzeu zommin – meshalleshin benehem. aval im heiduhu shehu chayyayv malkot arbaim venimtzeu zommin – kol echad veechad loke arbaim.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar abbaye: neemar "rasha" bechayyayve malkiyyot, veneemar "rasha" bechayyayve mitot bet din. ma lehallan – en mita lemechetza, af kan – en malkot lemechetza.
Rava amar: bainan "kaasher zamam laasot leachiv", velekka. i hachi, mamon name! mamon mitztaref, malkot la mitztaref.
Mishna en haedim naasim zommin ad sheyyazemmu et atzman.

Ketzad? amru "meidin ani beish peloni sheharag et hannefesh". amru lahem: "heach attem meidin? shehare neherag ze o hahoreg ze haya immanu oto hayyom bemakom peloni!" – en ellu zommin. aval amru lahem: "heach attem meidin? shehare attem heyitem immanu oto hayyom bemakom peloni!" – hare ellu zommin, veneheragin al pihem.
Bau acherim vehezimmum, bau acherim vehezimmum, afillu mea – kullam yehargu. rabbi yehuda omer: istatit hi zo, veeno neherag ella kat harishona bilvad.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav adda: deamar kera: "vehinne ed sheker haed sheker ana" – ad shettishshaker gufah shel edut.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "laanot bo sara" – ad shettisre gufah shel edut.

Amar rava: bau shenayim veamru: "bemizrach bira harag peloni et hannefesh", uvau shenayim veamru: "vahalo bemaarav bira immanu heyitem!", chazenan, i kidkayymi bemaarav bira michze chazu lemizrach bira – en ellu zommin, veim lav – hare ellu zommin.
Peshita! mahu detema: lechush linhora barya, kamashma lan.

Veamar rava: bau shenayim veamru "besura betzafra bechad beshabbeta harag peloni et hannefesh", uvau shenayim veamru: "befanya bechad beshabbeta immanu heyitem binhardea!", chazenan, i mitztzafra lefanya matze azel missura linhardea – la havu zommin, vei lav – havu zommin.
Peshita! mahu detema lechush legamla paracha, ka mashma lan.

Veamar rava: bau shenayim veamru "bechad beshabbeta harag peloni et hannefesh", uvau shenayim veamru "immanu heyitem bechad beshabbeta, ella bitre beshabbeta harag peloni et hannefesh". velo od, ella afillu amru "erev shabbat harag peloni et hannefesh" – neheragin, dividdana deka mashadi, gavra lav bar ketala hu.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: lefichach, nimtzet achat mehen zomemet – hu vahen neheragin, vehashsheniyya petura.

Sefa, "ma sheen ken bigmar din", itztericha leh: bau shenayim veamru "bechad beshabbeta nigmar dino shel peloni", uvau shenayim veamru "bechad beshabbeta immanu heyitem, ella beerev shabbat nigmar dino shel peloni". velo od, ella afillu amru "bitre beshabbeta nigmar dino shel peloni" – en ellu neheragin. dividdana deka mashadi, gavra bar ketala hu.
Vechen leinyan tashlume kenas:

Bau shenayim veamru "bechad beshabbeta ganav vetavach umachar", uvau shenayim veamru "bechad beshabbeta immanu heyitem, ella bitre beshabbeta ganav vetavach umachar" – meshallemin. velo od, ella afillu amru "beerev shabbat ganav vetavach umachar" – meshallemin, dividdana deka mashadi gavra lav bar tashlumin hu.

Bau shenayim veamru "bechad beshabbeta ganav vetavach umachar venigmar dino", uvau shenayim veamru "bechad beshabbeta immanu heyitem, ella erev shabbat ganav vetavach umachar venigmar dino", velo od, ella afillu amru "bechad beshabbeta ganav vetavach umachar, uvitre beshabbeta nigmar dino" – en meshallemin, dividdana deka mashadi gavra bar tashlumin hu.
Rabbi yehuda omer: istatit hi zo kulei.
b: I istatit hi zo, afillu kat rishona name la! amar rabbi avahu: shekadmu vehargu.
May dahava hava! ella amar rava, hachi kaamar: im enah ella kat achat – nehereget, i ikka tefe – en neheragin. ha "bilvad" kaamar! kashya.

Hahi itteta daatay sahadi veishtakkur, ayyti sahadi veishtakkur. azala ayyti sahadi acharine dela ishtakkur. amar resh lakish: huchezka zo. amar leh rabbi elazar: im hi huchezka, kol yisrael mi huchezku?

Zimnin havu yatvi kammeh derabbi yochanan, ata ki hay maase lekammayyhu. amar resh lakish: huchezka zo. amar leh rabbi yochanan: im huchezka zo – kol yisrael mi huchezku? hadar chazye lerabbi elazar bishut, amar leh: shamat mille mibbar nappacha vela amart li mishshemeh?
Lema resh lakish deamar kerabbi yehuda, verabbi yochanan deamar kerabbanan?
Amar lach resh lakish: ana daamari lach afillu lerabbanan – ad kan la ka amri rabbanan hatam, delekka deka mehaddar. aval hacha, ikka ha deka mehaddera.

Verabbi yochanan amar lach: ana daamari afillu lerabbi yehuda – ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam, deamrinan: "attu kulle alma gabbe hane havu kayymi?", aval hacha, hane yadi besahaduta, vehane la yadi besahaduta.
Mishna en haedim zommin neheragin ad sheyyiggamer haddin. shehare hatztzaddukin omrim: ad sheyyehareg, shenneemar "nefesh tachat nafesh".

Amru lahem chachamim: vahalo kevar neemar "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv", vahare achiv kayyaym! veim ken lamma neemar "nefesh tachat nafesh"? yachol mishshaa shekkibbelu edutan yehargu? talmud lomar: "nefesh tachat nafesh", ha enam neheragin ad sheyyiggamer haddin.
Gemara tana, beribbi omer: lo hargu – neheragin, hargu – en neheragin. amar aviv: beni, lav kal vachomer hu?

Amar lo: limmadtanu rabbenu sheen onshin min haddin. detanya: "ish asher yikkach [et] achoto bat aviv o vat immo", en li ella bat aviv shello bat immo uvat immo shello bat aviv. bat immo uvat aviv minnayin? talmud lomar: "ervat achoto gilla".
Ad shello yeamer yesh li baddin: im anash al bat aviv shello bat immo, uvat immo shello bat aviv – bat aviv uvat immo lo kol shekken? ha lamadta sheen onshin min haddin.

Onesh shamanu, azhara minnayin? talmud lomar "ervat achotcha vat avicha o vat immecha". en li ella bat aviv shello bat immo, uvat immo shello bat aviv. bat aviv uvat immo minnayin? talmud lomar: "ervat bat eshet avicha moledet avicha achotcha hiv".
Ad shello yeamer yesh li min haddin: ma im huzehar al bat immo shello bat aviv, uvat aviv shello bat immo, bat aviv uvat immo lo kol shekken? ha lamadta sheen mazhirin min haddin.
Chayyayve malkiyyot minnayin – talmud lomar "rasha" "rasha".
Chayyayve galiyyot minnayin – atya "rotzeach" "rotzeach".
Tanya, amar rabbi yehuda ben tavay: ere benechama im lo haragti ed zomem. lehotzi millibban shel tzaddukim, shehayu omrim: en haedim zommin neheragin ad sheyyehareg hanniddon.
Amar lo shimon ben shatach: ere benechama im lo shafachta dam naki, shehare amru chachamim: en haedim zommin neheragin ad sheyyizzommu shenehem, veen lokin ad sheyyizzommu shenehem.

Miyyad kibbel alav rabbi yehuda ben tavay sheeno more horaa ella lifne shimon ben shatach. vechol yamav shel rabbi yehuda ben tavay haya mishtatteach al kivro shel oto haed, vehaya kolo nishma, vechisvurin haam lomar: kolo shel harug. amar: koli shelli hu, tedu – lemachar hu met, en kolo nishma.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: dilma bedina kam bahadeh, i name payyose payyeyseh.

Mishna "al pi shenayim edim o shelosha edim yumat hammet" – im mitkayyemet haedut bishnayim lamma parat hakkatuv bishlosha? ella lehakkish shelosha lishnayim: ma shelosha mezimmin et hashshenayim, af hashshenayim yazommu et hashshelosha. uminnayin afillu mea? talmud lomar "edim".
Rabbi shimon omer: ma shenayim enan neheragin ad sheyyihyu shenehem zommin – af shelosha enan neheragin ad sheyyihyu sheloshtam zommin. uminnayin afillu mea – talmud lomar "edim".
Rabbi akiva omer: lo ba hashshelishi lehakel, ella lehachamir alav velaasot dino kayyotze baellu.
Veim ken anash hakkatuv lannitpal leovre avera keovre avera – al achat kamma vechamma yeshallem sachar lannitpal leose mitzva keose mitzva.
Uma shenayim nimtza echad mehen karov o pasul – edutan betela, af shelosha nimtza echad mehen karov o pasul – edutan betela. minnayin afillu mea? talmud lomar "edim".

a: Amar rabbi yose: bamme devarim amurim – bedine nefashot, aval bedine mamonot – titkayyem haedut bashshear. rabbi omer: echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot.
Veematay – bizman shehitru bahen. aval bizman shello hitru bahen, ma yaasu shene achin sherau beechad sheharag et hannefesh?!
Gemara amar rava: vehu sheheidu kullam betoch kede dibbur. amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: mikkedi toch kede dibbur hechi dame – kede sheelat talmid lerav. mea tuva havo!
Amar leh: kol chad vechad betoch kede dibbur shel chavero.
Rabbi akiva omer lo ba shelishi kulei. uma shenayim kulei. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: ella meatta, harug yatztzil! kesheharago meachorav.
Nirba yatztzil! keshervao meachorav.
Horeg verovea yatztzilu! ishtik. ki ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: "yakum davar" – bimkayyeme davar hakkatuv medabber.
Amar rabbi yose: bamme devarim amurim. kulei ma yaasu shene achim vechulei. hechi amrinan lehu?

Amar rava: hachi amrinan lehu: lemichze atitu o leashode atitu? i amri leashode ato, nimtza echad mehen karov o pasul – edutan betela, i amri lemichze ato, ma yaasu shene achin sherau beechad sheharag et hannefesh?
Ittemar, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose. verav nachman omer: halacha kerabbi.
b: Mishna hayu shenayim roin oto, mechallon ze, ushenayim roin oto mechallon ze, veechad matre bo baemtza, bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu – hare ellu edut achat, veim lav – hare ellu shete eduyot. lefichach, im nimtzet achat mehen zomemet – hu vahen neheragin, vehashsheniyya petura.
Rabbi yose omer: leolam en neheragin ad sheyyehu shene edav matrin bo, shenneemar "al pi shenayim edim". davar acher: "al pi shenayim edim" – shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi hatturegman.

Gemara amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: minnayin leedut meyuchedet shehi pesula? shenneemar: "lo yumat al pi ed echad". may echad? illema ed echad mammash – meresha shaminan lah, "al pi shenayim edim"! ella may "echad"? echad echad.

Tanya name hachi: "lo yumat al pi ed echad", lehavi shenayim sheroim oto echad mechallon ze veechad mechallon ze, veen roin ze et ze, sheen mitztarfin. velo od ella afillu beze achar ze bechallon echad – en mitztarfin.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: hasheta, uma echad mechallon ze veechad mechallon ze, dehay ka chaze kullo maase, vehay ka chaze kullo maase – amrat la mitztarfi, beze achar ze, dehay chaze palga demaase vehay chaze palga demaase, mibbaya? amar leh: lo nitzrecha ella levoel et haerva.
Amar rava: im hayu roin et hammatre, o hammatre roe otan – mitztarfin. amar rava: matre sheamru, afillu mippi atzmo, vaafillu mippi hashshed.
Amar rav nachman: edut meyuchedet keshera bedine mamonot, dichtiv: "lo yumat al pi ed echad" – bedine nefashot hu deen keshera, aval bedine mamonot – keshera.
Matkef la rav zutera: ella meatta bedine nefashot tatztzil! allema tenan "hu vahen neheragin"? kashya.
Rabbi yose omer vechulei. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: umi it leh lerabbi yose hay sevara? vehatnan rabbi yose omer: hassone – neherag, mippene shehu kemuad umutere.
Amar leh: hahu – rabbi yose bar yehuda hi. detanya: rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: chaver en tzarich hateraa, lefi shello nittena hateraa ella lehavechin ben shogeg lemezid.

Davar acher: "al pi shenayim edim" – shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi hatturegman. hanhu laoze daato lekammeh derava, oki rava turegman benayyhu. vehechi avid hachi? vehatnan: shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi hatturegman! rava midda hava yada ma dahavo amri, veahdore hu dela hava yada.

a: Ila vetoviyya, kariveh dearva havo. sevar rav pappa lememar: gabbe love umalve rachiki ninhu. amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: i let leh lelove, lav batar arva azel malve?

Mishna mi shennigmar dino, uvarach, uva lifne oto bet din – en sotrin et dino. kol makom sheyyaamdu shenayim veyomru: "meidim anu beish peloni shennigmar dino bevet din shel peloni, ufeloni ufeloni edav" – hare ze yehareg.

Sanhedrin noheget baaretz uvechutza laaretz. sanhedrin hahoreget echad beshavua nikret chovlanit. rabbi eliezer ben azarya omer: echad leshivim shana. rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva omrim: illu hayinu besanhedrin lo neherag adam meolam. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af hen marbin shofche damim beyisrael.

Gemara lifne oto bet din hu deen sotrin, ha lifne bet din acher – sotrin. ha tane sefa: kol makom sheyyaamdu shenayim veyomru: "meidin anu et ish peloni shennigmar dino bevet din peloni, ufeloni ufeloni edav" – hare ze neherag!
Amar abbaye: la kashya, kan beeretz yisrael, kan bechutza laaretz.

Detanya: rabbi yehuda ben dostay omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben shatach: barach mearetz lechutza laaretz – en sotrin et dino. mechutza laaretz laaretz – sotrin et dino, mippene zechutah shel eretz yisrael.
Sanhedrin noheget kulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "vehayu elle lachem lechukkat mishpat ledorotechem", lamadnu lesanhedrin shennoheget baaretz uvechutza laaretz.
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "bisharecha"? bisharecha atta moshiv batte dinim bechol pelech vafelech uvechol ir vair, uvechutza laaretz atta moshiv bechol pelech vafelech, vei atta moshiv bechol ir vair.
Sanhedrin hahoreget vechulei. ibbaya lehu: achat leshivim shana nikret chabbelanit, o dilma orach ara hi? teku.
Rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva omrim: illu hayinu vechulei. hechi havo avdi? rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: reitem terefa harag, shalem harag?
Amar rav ashe: im timtza lomar shalem hava, dilma bimkom sayif nekev hava.
Bevoel et haerva hechi havo avdi? abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: reitem kemichchol bishfoferet? verabbanan, hechi dayynu? kishmuel, deamar shemuel: bimnaafim – mishsheyyiru kimnaafim.
Hadaran alach ketzad haedim

Mishna ellu hen haggolin: hahoreg nefesh bishgaga, haya meaggel bammagela venafla alav vaharagattu, haya meshalshel bechavit venafla alav vaharagattu, haya yored bassullam venafal alav (vaharagattu) [vaharago] – hare ze gole. aval im haya moshech bammagela venafla alav vaharagattu, haya dole bechavit venifsak hachevel venafla alav vaharagattu
b: Haya ole bassullam venafal alav vaharago – hare ze eno gole. ze hakkelal: kol shebbederech yeridato – gole, veshello bederech yeridato – eno gole.
Gemara mena hane mille? deamar shemuel deamar kera: "vayyappel alav vayyamot" – ad sheyyippol derech nefila.
Tanu rabbanan: "bishgaga" – perat lemezid. "bivli daat" – perat lemitkavven.
Mezid? peshita, bar ketala hu! ella amar rava: ema perat leomer muttar. amar leh abbaye: i omer muttar, anus hu? amar leh: sheani omer, haomer muttar – karov lemezid hu.
"Bivli daat" – perat lemitkavven. mitkavven? peshita, bar ketala hu! amar rabba: perat lemitkavven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam, laggoy veharag et yisrael, lannefel veharag ben kayyayma.

Tanu rabbanan: "im befeta" – perat lekeren zavit. "belo eva" – perat lesone. "hadafo" – sheddechafo begufo. "o hishlich alav" – lehavi yerida shehi tzorech aliyya. "belo tzediyya" – perat lemitkavven letzad ze vehalcha lah letzad acher.

"Vaasher lo tzada" – perat lemitkavven lizrok shetayim, vezarak arba. "vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar" – ma yaar reshut lannizzak velammazzik likkanes lesham, af kol reshut lannizzak velammazzik likkanes lesham.

Bea minneh rabbi avahu merabbi yochanan: haya ole bassullam venishmeta sheliva mittachtav, venafla veharga, mahu? ki hay gavvna aliyya hi, o yerida hi? amar leh: kevar nagata birida shehi tzorech aliyya.

Etiveh, ze hakkelal: kol shebbederech yeridato – gole, shello bederech yeridato – eno gole. shello bederech yeridato leetoye may? lav leetoye kehay gavvna? velitamaych, kol shebbederech yeridato, leetoye may?

Ella leetoye katztzav, hacha name leetoye katztzav. detanya: katztzav shehaya mekatztzev, tana chada: lefanav – chayyayv, leacharav – patur. vetanya iddach: leacharav – chayyayv, lefanav – patur. vetanya iddach: ben lefanav ben leacharav – chayyayv, vetanya iddach: ben lefanav ben leacharav – patur. vela kashya.
Kan – birida shellefanav, vaaliyya shelleacharav. kan – baaliyya shellefanav, virida shelleacharav.
Kan – birida shellefanav veshel acharav, kan – baaliyya shellefanav veshel acharav.
Lema ketannae: haya ole bassullam venishmeta sheliva mittachtav, tane chada chayyayv, vetanya iddach patur. may lav beha ka mippalgi, demar savar yerida hi, umar savar aliyya hi?
La, dechulle alma aliyya hi. vela kashya: kan linyzakin, kan legalut.
Ibbaet ema ha veha legalut, vela kashya, ha deatlay, ha dela atla.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha dela atla, vela kashya, ha demihaddak, veha dela mihaddak.
Mishna nishmat habbarzel mikkatto veharag, rabbi omer: eno gole, vachachamim omrim: gole. min haetz hammitbakkea, rabbi omer: gole, vachachamim omrim: eno gole.

Gemara tanya, amar lahem rabbi lachachamim: vechi neemar "venashal habbarzel meetzo"? vahalo lo neemar ella "min haetz"! veod, neemar "etz" lematta veneemar "etz" lemala, ma "etz" haamur lemala min haetz hammitbakkea, af "etz" haamur lematta min haetz hammitbakkea.

Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: ushenehem mikra echad darshu: "venashal habbarzel min haetz", rabbi savar: yesh em lammasoret, "venishshel" ketiv, verabbanan savri: yesh em lammikra, "venashal" karenan.
Verabbi, yesh em lammasoret sevira leh?

a: Vehaamar rav yitzchak berabbi yosef amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi, verabbi yehuda ben roetz, uvet shammay, verabbi shimon, verabbi akiva, kullehu seviri lehu yesh em lammikra! hayeynu dekaamar lehu "veod".
Amar rav pappa: man dishda pissa ledikla veattar tamre, vaazul tamre uketul, banu lemachloket derabbi verabbanan. peshita! mahu detema, kechoach kocho dame, ka mashma lan.
Ella koach kocho lerabbi hechi mashkachat la? kegon dishda pissa umachaye legirma, vaazal girma umachaye lichvasa veattar tamre, vaazul tamre uketul.
Mishna hazzorek even lirshut harabbim veharag – hare ze gole. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: im mikkesheyyatzata haeven miyyado hotzi halla et rosho vekibbelah – hare ze patur.

Zarak et haeven lachatzero veharag, im yesh reshut lannizzak likkanes lesham – gole, veim lav – eno gole, shenneemar: "vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar" – ma hayyaar reshut lannizzak velammazzik likkanes lesham, af kol reshut lannizzak velammazzik lehikkanes lesham. yatza chatzar baal habbayit, sheen reshut lannizzak velammazzik likkanes lesham.
Abba shaul omer: ma chatavat etzim reshut, af kol reshut, yatza haav hammakke et beno, veharav harode et talmido, usheliach bet din.
Gemara lirshut harabbim, mezid hu! amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: besoter et kotlo. ibbei leh leayyone! besoter et kotlo ballayla. ballayla name ibbei leh leayyone!
Besoter et kotlo leashpa. hay ashpa hechi dame? i shechichi ba rabbim – poshea hu, i la shechichi ba rabbim – anus hu!

Amar rav pappa: la tzericha ella leashpa haasuya lippanot bah ballayla, veen asuya lippanot bah bayyom, veikka demikkere veyatev. poshea la have – deha enah asuya lippanot bah bayyom, ones name la have, deha ikka demikkere veyatev.

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "umatza" – perat lemamtzi et atzmo. mikkan amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: im mishsheyyatzata haeven miyyado hotzi halla et rosho vekibbelah, patur.
Lememra dematza" meikkara mashma? ureminhi: "umatza" – perat lematzuy, shello yimkor berachok veyigol bekarov, beraa veyigol beyafa!

Amar rava: hacha meinyayneh dikra vehatam meinyayneh dikra. hatam meinyayneh dikra, "umatza" dumeya divhissiga yado", ma "hissiga yado" mehasheta, af "matza" name mehasheta. hacha meinyayneh dikra, "umatza" dumeya deyaar, ma yaar midde deiteh meikkara, af "umatza" name midde deiteh meikkara.

Hazzorek et haeven vechulei. amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava: mimmay demachatavat etzim dirshut? dilma mechatavat etzim desukka, umechatavat etzim demaaracha, vaafillu hachi amar rachamana ligle! amar leh kevan deim matza chatuv eno chotev, lav mitzva, hasheta name – lav mitzva.

Etiveh ravina lerava: yatza haav hammakke et beno, veharav harode et talmido, usheliach bet din. lema: kevan deillu gemir lav mitzva, hasheta name, lav mitzva! hatam af al gav digmir mitzva, dichtiv: "yasser bincha vinichecha veyitten maadannim lenafshecha".
Hadar amar rava: lav milleta hi daamari. "vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar", ma yaar dei bae ayel vei bae la ayel, vei salka datach mitzva, mi saggi dela ayel?

Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava: kol hecha dichtiv "asher", dei bae hu? ella meatta "veish asher yitma velo yitchatta" – i bae mittamme i bae la mittamme. met mitzva, dela saggi dela mittamme, hachi name defatur?
Shane hatam, deamar kera:
b: "Tame yihye" – mikkol makom.
Hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "tame yihye" – lerabbot tevul yom, "tumeato vo" – lerabbot mechussar kippurim! amar leh: ana meod tumeato" ka amena.

Ikka dematne la aha: "becharish uvakkatzir tishbot", rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich lomar charish shel sheviit vekatzir shel sheviit, shehare kevar neemar "sadcha lo tizra vecharmecha lo tizmor", ella afillu charish shel erev sheviit shennichnas lishviit, vekatzir shel sheviit sheyyatza lemotzae sheviit.
Rabbi yishmael omer: ma charish reshut – af katzir reshut. yatza ketzir haomer shehu mitzva.
Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava: mimmay dacharisha dirshut? dilma charishat omer demitzva, vaafillu hachi amar rachamana "tishbot"! amar leh: kevan deim matza charush eno choresh, lav mitzva.

Etiveh ravina lerava: yatza haav hammakke et beno, veharav harode et talmido, usheliach bet din. veammay? lema kevan deillu gemir lav mitzva, hasheta name – lav mitzva! hatam af al gav digmir name mitzva ka aved, dichtiv: "yasser bincha vinichecha".

Hadar amar rava: lav milleta hi daamari. ketzira dumeya dacharisha, ma charisha, matza charush – eno choresh, af ketzira name, matza katzur eno kotzer, vei salka datach mitzva, matza katzur eno kotzer?! mitzva liktzor ulehavi!
Mishna haav gole al yede habben, vehabben gole al yede haav. hakkol golin al yede yisrael, veyisrael golin al yedehen, chutz migger toshav. veger toshav eno gole ella al yede ger toshav.
Gemara haav gole al yede habben. vehaamrat: yatza haav hammakke et beno! digmir. haamrat af al gav digmir mitzva kaaved! bishvalya denaggare.
Shevalya denaggare – chayyute hi delammedeh! digmir ummanuta achariti.
Vehabben gole al yede haav kulei. ureminhi, "makke nefesh" – perat lammakka aviv. amar rav kahana: la kashya, ha rabbi shimon veha rabbanan.
Lerabbi shimon, deamar chenek chamur missayif, shiggat sayif nittena lechappara, shiggat chenek lo nittena lechappara.
Lerabbanan, deamri sayif chamur mechenek, horeg aviv [beshogeg] shiggat sayif hu, veshiggat sayif nittena lechappara.
Rava amar: perat leose chabbura beaviv beshogeg. salka datach amena: kevan divmezid bar ketala hu, beshogeg name ligle, ka mashma lan.

Hakkol golin al yede yisrael vechulei. "hakkol golin al yede yisrael" leetoye may? leetoye eved vechuti. tenena leha detanu rabbanan: eved vechuti gole veloke al yede yisrael veyisrael gole veloke al yede kuti veeved.

Bishlama eved vechuti gole al yede yisrael veloke, gole – dekatleh, veloke – delatyeh. ella yisrael gole veloke al yede kuti? bishlama gole – dekatleh, ella loke, ammay? delatyeh? "venasi veammecha lo taor" – beose maase ammecha!
Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov: kegon sheheid bo vehuzam. dichvoteh gabbe eved, sheheid bo vehuzam, eved bar edut hu? ella amar rav acha bereh derav ika: hacha bemay askinan, kegon shehikkahu hakkaa

a: Sheen bah shave peruta. deamar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: hikkahu hakkaa sheen bah shave peruta – loke. vela makkeshinan hakkaa liklala.

Chutz meal yede ger toshav vechulei. alma ger toshav goy hu. ema sefa: ger toshav gole al yede ger toshav! amar rav kahana: la kashya, kan beger toshav sheharag ger toshav, kan beger toshav sheharag yisrael.

Ikka derame kerae ahadade, ketiv: "livne yisrael velagger velattoshav betocham tihyena shesh hearim", uchetiv: "vehayu lachem hearim lemiklat", "lachem" – velo legerim! amar rav kahana: la kashya, kan – beger toshav sheharag yisrael, kan – beger toshav sheharag ger toshav.

Ureminhi: lefichach ger vegoy shehargu – neheragin. katane ger dumeya degoy: ma goy la shena diktal bar minneh, vela shena diktal delav bar mineh – neherag, af ger, la shena diktal bar minneh vela shena ketal delav bar mineh – neherag!
Amar rav chisda: la kashya, kan sheharago derech yerida, kan sheharago derech aliyyay. derech yerida, deyisrael gale – ihu name saggi leh begalut. derech aliyyay, deyisrael patur – hu neherag.
Amar leh rava: velav kal vachomer hu? uma derech yerida deyisrael gale, ihu name saggi leh begalut, derech aliyyay, deyisrael patur, ihu neherag?!
Ella amar rava: beomer muttar. amar leh abbaye: omer muttar anus hu! amar leh: sheani omer, omer muttar – karov lemezid hu.
Veazdu letamayyhu, deittemar: kesavur behema venimtza adam, goy venimtza ger toshav. rava omer: chayyayv, omer muttar karov lemezid hu. rav chisda omer: patur, omer muttar anus hu.
Etiveh rava lerav chisda: "hinnecha met al haishsha asher lakachta". may lav bide adam?
La, bide shamayim. dayka name, dichtiv: "mechato li".
Uletamaych, "vechatati lelohim" – lelohim velo leadam? ella, dino masur leadam, hacha name dino masur laadam.
Etiveh abbaye lerava: "hagoy gam tzaddik taharog"! hatam kidka mehadderi illaveh: "veatta hashev eshet haish ki navi hu" –
b: Eshet navi hu detehdar, delav navi la tehdar?!

Ella kidamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani. deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: hachi kaamar leh: "veatta hashev eshet haish", mikkol makom. udekaamrat: "hagoy gam tzaddik taharog, halo hu amar li achoti hi vegomer" – navi hu umimmecha lamad. achsenay (hu) shebba lair, al iske achila ushetiyyay shoalin oto, kelum shoalin oto "ishtecha zo" "achotcha zo"?
Mikkan shebben noach neherag, shehaya lo lilmod velo lamad.

Mishna hassome eno gole, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: gole. hassone eno gole. rabbi yose omer: hassone neherag, mippene shehu kemuad. rabbi shimon omer: yesh sone gole veyesh sone sheeno gole. ze hakkelal: kol shehu yachol lomar ledaat harag – eno gole, veshello ledaat harag – hare ze gole.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "belo reot" – perat lesome, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: "belo reot" – lerabbot et hassome.
May tama derabbi yehuda – dichtiv: "vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar" – afillu some. ata "belo reot", maateh.
Verabbi meir: "belo reot" – lemaet, "bivli daat" – lemaet, have miut achar miut, veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot.
Verabbi yehuda? "bivli daat" – perat lemitkavven hu daata.

Rabbi yose omer hassone neherag kulei. veha la atro beh! matnitin rabbi yose bar yehuda hi, detanya: rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: chaver eno tzarich hateraa, lefi shello nittena hateraa ella lehavechin ben shogeg lemezid.
Rabbi shimon omer: yesh sone gole vechulei. tanya: ketzad amar rabbi shimon yesh sone gole veyesh sone sheeno gole? nifsak – gole, nishmat – eno gole.
Vehatanya rabbi shimon omer: leolam eno gole ad sheyyishshamet machtzalo miyyado. kashya nifsak annifsak, kashya nishmat annishmat!
Nifsak annifsak la kashya: ha beohev, veha besone.
Nishmat annishmat la kashya: ha rabbi, veha rabbanan.

Mishna lehechan golin? leare miklat, leshalosh shebbeever hayyarden uleshalosh shebbeeretz kenaan. shenneemar: "et shelosh hearim tittenu meever layyarden veet shelosh hearim tittenu beeretz kenaan vegomer". ad shello nivcharu shalosh shebbeeretz yisrael lo hayu shalosh shebbeever hayyarden koltot, shenneemar: "shesh are miklat tihyena" – ad sheyyihyu sheshtan koltot keachat.
Umechuuonot lahen derachim mizzo lazo, shenneemar: "tachin lecha hadderech veshillashta vegomer".
Umosrin lahen shene talmide chachamim, shemma yahargennu badderech, vidabberu elav. rabbi meir omer: af hu medabber al yede atzmo, shenneemar: "veze devar harotzeach".

Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: battechilla, echad shogeg veechad mezid makdimin leare miklat uvet din sholchin umeviin oto mishsham. mi shennitchayyev mita bevet din – haraguhu, veshello nitchayyev mita – petaruhu. mi shennitchayyev galut – machzirin oto limkomo, shenneemar: "veheshivu oto haeda el ir miklato vegomer".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: shalosh arim hivdil moshe beever hayyarden uchenegdan hivdil yehoshua beeretz kenaan, umechuuonot hayu kemin shete shurot shebbakkerem: chevron behar yehuda keneged betzer bammidbar, shechem behar efrayim keneged ramot baggilad, kedesh behar naftali keneged golan babbashan. "veshillashta" – sheyyehu meshullashin, sheyyehe middarom lechevron kemechevron lishchem, umechevron lishchem kemishshechem lekedesh, umishshechem lekedesh kemikkedesh latztzafon.
Beever hayyarden telat, beeretz yisrael telat?! amar abbaye: begilad shechichi rotzchim,

a: Dichtiv: "gilad kiryat poale aven akubba middam", may "akubba middam"? amar rabbi elazar: shehayu okvin laharog nefashot.
Umay shena mehay gisa umehay gisa dimrachaki, umay shena metziae dimkarvi?

Amar abbaye: bishchem name shechichi rotzchim, dichtiv: "uchechakke ish gedudim chever kohanim, derech yeratztzechu shechma vegomer", may "chever kohanim"? amar rabbi elazar: shehayu mitchabberin laharog nefashot, kechohanim hallalu shemmitchabberin lachlok terumot bevet haggoranot.
Vetu lekka? veha ketiv: "vaalehem tittenu arbaim ushetayim ir"! amar abbaye: hallalu, koltot ben ledaat ben shello ledaat. hallalu – ledaat koltot, shello ledaat enan koltot.
Vechevron ir miklat hava[10]? vehachtiv: "vayyittenu lechalev et chevron kaasher dibber moshe"! amar abbaye: parvodeha, dichtiv: "veet sede hair veet chatzereha natnu lechalev ben yefunne".

Vekedesh ir miklat havay? vehachtiv: "veare mivtzar hatztziddim tzer vechammat rakkat vechinnaret vegomer vekedesh veedrei veen chatzor", vetanya: arim hallalu en osin otan lo tirin ketannim velo kerakkim gedolim ella ayayrot benoniyyot! amar rav yosef: tarte kedesh havay. (amar) rav ashe [amar]: kegon selekum veakra dislekum.

Gufa: arim hallalu, en osin otan lo tirin ketannim velo kerakkin gedolim, ella ayayrot benoniyyot. veen moshivin otan ella bimkom mayim, veim en sham mayim – meviin lahem mayim. veen moshivin otan ella bimkom shevokim, veen moshivin otan ella bimkom uchelusin. nitmaatu uchelusehen – mosifin alehen. nitmaatu diyyurehen – meviin lahem kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim.

Veen mochrin bahen lo kele zayin, velo kele metzuda, divre rabbi nechemya. vachachamim mattirin. veshavin sheen porsin betochan metzudot, veen mafshilin letochan chavalim, kede shello tehe regel goel haddam metzuya sham.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: may kera? "venas el achat min hearim hael vachay" – aved leh midde detehve leh chiyyuta.
Tana: talmid sheggala – maggelin rabbo immo, shenneemar: "vachay" – aved leh midde detehve leh chiyyuta. amar rabbi zeera: mikkan shello yishne adam letalmid sheeno hagun.

Amar rabbi yochanan: harav sheggala – maggelin yeshivato immo. ini? veha amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin ledivre tora shehen koltin? shenneemar: "et betzer bammidbar vegomer", [uchetiv batreh:] "vezot hattora".
La kashya, ha – beiddana deasek ba, ha – beiddana dela asek ba.

Vei baet ema, may koltin – mimmalach hammavet. ki ha derav chisda hava yatev vegares beve rav, vela hava ka yachel shelicha [demalacha demota] lemikrav legabbeh, dela hava shatek pummeh miggirsa, selek vitev aarza deve rav, peka arza ushetek, vichel leh.
Amar rabbi tanchum bar chanilay: mippene ma zacha reuven limmanot behatztzala techilla? mippene shehu patach behatztzala techilla, shenneemar: "vayyishma reuven vayyatztzilehu miyyadam".

Darash rabbi simlay: may dichtiv: "az yavdil moshe shalosh arim beever hayyarden mizrecha [shamesh]"? amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: hazerach shemesh larotzchim. ikka deamri amar lo: hizrachta shemesh larotzchim.

Darash rabbi simay: may dichtiv: "ohev kesef lo yisba kesef umi ohev behamon lo tevua"? "ohev kesef lo yisba kesef" – ze moshe rabbenu, shehaya yodea sheen shalosh arim shebbeever hayyarden koltot ad shello nivcharu shalosh beeretz kenaan, veamar: mitzva shebbaa leyadi akayyeymenna.

"Umi ohev behamon lo tevua" – lemi nae lelammed behamon? mi shekkol tevua shello. vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar: "may dichtiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato"? lemi nae (lelammed) [lemallel] gevurot Adonai – mi sheyyachol lehashemia kol tehillato.
Verabbanan, veittema rabba bar mari, amar: "mi ohev behamon lo tevua" – kol haohev (limlammed) behamon – lo tevua. yehavu beh rabbanan enayyhu berava bereh derabba.
(Siman: ashe lilmod, ravina lelammed).

Rav ashe amar: kol haohev lilmod behamon – lo tevua. vehayeynu deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may dichtiv: "cherev el habbaddim venoalu"? cherev al tzavvere sonehem shel talmide chachamim, sheyyoshvin veoskin battora bad bevad, velo od ella shemmittappeshin – ketiv hacha: "venoalu", uchetiv hatam: "asher noalnu". velo od ella shechotin, shenneemar: "vaasher chatanu". veibbaet ema mehacha: "noalu sare tzoan".
Ravina amar: kol haohev lelammed behamon – lo tevua. vehayeynu deamar rabbi: harebe tora lamadti merabbotay, umechaveray yoter mehem, umittalmiday yoter mikkullan.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv: "omdot hayu raglenu bisharayich yerushalam"? mi garam leraglenu sheyyaamdu bammilchama – shaare yerushalami, shehayu oskim battora.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv: "shir hammaalot ledavid samachti beomrim li bet Adonai nelech"? amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, shamati bene adam shehayu omrim: "matay yamut zaken ze, veyavo shelomo beno veyivne bet habbechira venaale laregel?", vesamachti. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: "ki tov yom bachatzerecha mealef" – tov li yom echad sheatta osek battora lefanay, meelef olot sheatid shelomo bincha lehakeriv lefanay al gabbe hammizbeach.
Umechuuonot lahem derachim vechulei. tanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer:
b: "Miklat" haya katuv al parashat derachim, kede sheyyakkir harotzeach veyifne lesham. amar rav kahana: may kera? "tachin lecha hadderech" – ase [lecha] hachana ladderech.
Rav chama bar chanina patach la pitcha lehay parashta mehacha: "tov veyashar Adonai al ken yore chattaim baddarech" – im lachattaim yore, kal vachomer latztzaddikim.
Rabbi shimon ben lakish patach la pitcha lehay parashta mehacha: "vaasher lo tzada vehaelohim inna leyado vegomer", "kaasher yomar meshal hakkadmoni mershaim yetze resha vegomer",

Bamma hakkatuv medabber – bishne bene adam shehargu et hannefesh, echad harag beshogeg veechad harag bemezid, laze en edim velaze en edim. hakkadosh baruch hu mazminan lefunedak echad, ze sheharag bemezid yoshev tachat hassullam, veze sheharag beshogeg yored bassullam, venofel alav vehorgo, ze sheharag bemezid – neherag, veze sheharag beshogeg – gole.
Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav huna, veamri la amar rav huna amar rabbi elazar: min hattora umin hanneviim umin hakketuvim – badderech sheadam rotze lelech bah – molichin oto.

Min hattora, dichtiv: "lo telech immahem", uchetiv: "kum lech ittam". min hanneviim – dichtiv: "ani Adonai elohecha melammedcha lehoil madrichcha bederech (zu) telech". min hakketuvim – dichtiv: "im lalletzim hu yalitz velaanavim yitten chen".
Amar rav huna: rotzeach sheggala leir miklat umetzao goel haddam vaharago – patur. kasavar: "velo en mishpat mavet" – begoel haddam hu dichtiv.

Metivi: "velo en mishpat mavet" – barotzeach hakkatuv medabber. atta omer barotzeach, o eno ella begoel haddam? keshehu omer: "vehu lo sone lo mittemol shilshom" – heve omer barotzeach hakkatuv medabber.

Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: "velo en mishpat mavet" – begoel haddam hakkatuv medabber. atta omer begoel haddam hakkatuv medabber, o eno ella barotzeach? keshehu omer: "ki lo sone hu lo mittemol shilshom" – hare rotzeach amur, ha ma ani mekayyem: "velo en mishpat mavet"? begoel haddam hakkatuv medabber.
Tenan: mosrin lo shene talmide chachamim, shemma yahargennu badderech, vidabberu elav. may lav dematru beh, dei katel bar ketala hu?

La, kidtanya: vidabberu elav – devarim haruyim lo. omrim lo: al tinhag bo minhag shofche damim, bishgaga ba maase leyado. rabbi meir omer: hu medabber al yede atzmo, shenneemar: "veze devar harotzeach". amru lo: harebe shelichut osa.
Amar mar: bishgaga ba maase leyado. peshita! dei bemezid, bar galut hu? in.
Veha tanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: battechilla, echad shogeg veechad mezid makdimin leare miklat, uvet din sholchin umeviin otam mishsham.

Mi shennitchayyev mita – haraguhu, shenneemar: "veshalchu zikne iro velakchu oto mishsham venatnu oto beyad goel haddam vamet". mi shello nitchayyev – petaruhu, shenneemar: "vehitztzilu haeda et harotzeach miyyad goel haddam". mi shennitchayyev galut – machzirin oto limkomo, shenneemar: "veheshivu oto haeda el ir miklato asher nas shamma".
Rabbi omer: meatzman hen golin. kisvurin hen echad shogeg veechad mezid – koltot, vehen enan yodin shebbashshogeg koltot, bemezid enan koltot.
Amar rabbi elazar: ir sherubbah rotzchim – enah koletet, shenneemar: "vedibber beozne zikne hair hahi et devarav" – velo shehushevu divrehen lidvarav.

Veamar rabbi elazar: ir sheen bah zekenim enah koletet, devaenan "zikne hair" velekka. ittemar: ir sheen bah zekenim, rabbi amme verabbi assi – chad omer: koletet, vechad omer: enah koletet. leman deamar enah koletet – baenan "zikne hair", velekka. leman deamar koletet – mitzva bealma.

Veir sheen bah zekenim – rabbi amme verabbi assi, chad amar: naase bah ben sorer umore, vechad amar: en naase bah ben sorer umore. leman deamar en naase bah ben sorer umore – baenan "zikne iro", velekka. leman deamar naase bah ben sorer umore – mitzva bealma.

Veir sheen bah zekenim, rabbi amme verabbi assi – chad amar: mevia egla arufa, vechad amar: enah mevia egla arufa. leman deamar enah mevia egla arufa – baenan "zikne hair hahi", velekka. leman deamar mevia egla arufa – mitzva bealma.
Amar rabbi chama bar chanina: mippene ma neemra parashat rotzchim

a: Belashon azza, dichtiv: "vaydabber Adonai el yehoshua lemor dabber el bene yisrael lemor tenu lachem et are hammiklat asher dibbarti alechem vegomer"? mippene shehen shel hattora.

Lememra dechol dibbur lashon kasha? in, kedichtiv: "dibber haish adone haaretz ittanu kashot". vehatanya: "nidberu", en "nidberu" ella leshon nachat, vechen hu omer "yadber ammim tachtenu"! "dibber" lechud, "yadber" lechud.
(Simane rabbanan mehemne vesafre).
Peligi ba rabbi yehuda verabbanan, chad omer: mippene sheshshiham. vechad omer: mippene shehen shel tora.
"Vayyichtov yehoshua et haddevarim haelle besefer torat elohim", peligi ba rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya – chad omer: shemona pesukim, vechad omer: are miklat.

Bishlama leman deamar shemona pesukim, hayeynu dichtiv: "besefer torat elohim". ella leman deamar are miklat, may "besefer torat elohim"? hachi kaamar: "vayyichtov yehoshua besifro et haddevarim haelle hakketuvim besefer torat elohim".
Sefer shettefaro befishtan, peligi ba rabbi yehuda verabbi meir – chad omer: kasher, vechad omer: pasul.

Leman deamar pasul, dichtiv: "lemaan tihye torat Adonai beficha", veittakkash kol hattora kullah litfillin: ma tefillin halacha lemoshe missinay letofran begidin – af kol letofran begidin. veiddach: ki ittakkash – lammuttar befich, lehilchotav la ittakkash.
Amar rav: chazenan lehu litfillin deve chavivi ditfiri bechittana, velet hilcheta kevoteh.
Mishna echad mashuach beshemen hammishcha, veechad hamerubbe bivgadim, veechad sheavar mimmeshichuto – machazirin et harotzeach. rabbi yehuda omer: af meshuach milchama machazir et harotzeach.
Lefichach immotehen shel kohanim mesappekot lahen michya uchesut, kede shello yitpallelu al benehem sheyyamutu.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav kahana: deamar kera: "veyashav bah ad mot hakkohen haggadol", uchetiv: "ki veir miklato yeshev ad mot hakkohen haggadol", uchetiv: "veachare mot hakkohen haggadol".
Verabbi yehuda? ketiv kera acharina: "lashuv lashevet baaretz ad mot hakkohen". (vegomer) veiddach: middela ketiv: "haggadol" – chad mehanach hu.

Lefichach immotehen shel kohanim kulei. tama dela metzallu, ha metzallu – mayyti? vehachtiv: "katztzippor lanud kadderor lauf ken killat chinnam lo tavo"! amar leh hahu sava: mippirkeh derava shemia li, shehaya lahen levakkesh rachamim al doran velo bikkeshu.
Veikka dematne: kede sheyyitpallelu al benehem shello yamutu. tama dimtzallu, ha la metzallu – mayyti? may hava leh lemebad? hacha amrinan: toviyya chata veziggud minnaggayd.
Hatam amri: shechem nasev umivgay gazayr.

Amar leh hahu sava: mippirkeh derava shemia li, shehaya lahen levakkesh rachamim al doran velo bikkeshu. ki ha dehahu gavra deachleh arya berachok telata parse minneh derabbi yehoshua ben levi, vela ishtai eliyyahu bahadeh telata yome.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: killat chacham – afillu bechinnam hi baa. menalan? meachitofel, shebbeshaa shekkara david shitin, kefa tehoma, bea lemishtefa lealma. amar: mahu lichtov shem achaspa umishde bithoma deleku adducheteh? lekka deamar leh midde. amar: kol hayyodea davar ze veeno omro – yechanek bigrono.

Nasa achitofel kal vachomer beatzmo, amar: uma laasot shalom ben ish leishto, amra hattora: shemi shennichtav bikdushsha yimmache al hammayim, lechol haolam kullo lo kol shekken? amar leh: shere. ketav shem achaspa, sheda attehoma, nechat vekam adducheteh.
Vaafillu hachi ketiv: "vaachitofel raa ki lo neesta atzato vayyachavosh et hachamor vayyakom vayyelech el beto (v)el iro vaytzav el beto vayyechanak vegomer".

Amar rabbi avahu: killat chacham – afillu al tenay hi baa. menalan? meeli, dekaamar leh [eli] lishmuel: "ko yaase lecha elohim vecho yosif im techached mimmenni davar". veaf al gav dichtiv: "vayyagged lo shemuel et kol haddevarim velo chiched mimmennu", [vaafillu hachi] ketiv: "velo halchu vanav bidrachav vegomer".
b: Amar rav yehuda amar rav: nidduy al tenay – tzarich hafara. menalan? miyyehuda, dichtiv: "im lo haviotiv elecha vegomer", veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: may dichtiv: "yechi reuven veal yamot, vegomer vezot lihuda"?

Kol otan arbaim shana shehayu yisrael bammidbar, atzmotav shel yehuda hayu megulegalin baaron, ad sheamad moshe uvikkesh alav rachamim. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mi garam liruven sheyyode – yehuda, "vezot lihuda... shema Adonai kol yehuda".

Al ivreh leshafa, la hava ka meayyeyli leh limtivta derakia, "veel ammo teviennu". la hava ka yada lemishkal umitrach bishmata bahade rabbanan, "yadav rav lo". la hava yada lefaroke kusheya, "veezer mitztzarav tihye".
Ibbaya lehu: bemitat kullan hu chozer, o dilma bemitat echad mehen?
Ta shema: nigmar dino belo kohen gadol – eno yotze mishsham leolam. veim ita, lihdar beh bidhanach! bidlekka.

Mishna mishshennigmar dino met kohen gadol – hare ze eno gole. im ad shello nigmar dino met kohen gadol uminnu acher tachtav uleachar mikken nigmar dino – chozer bemitato shel sheni. nigmar dino belo kohen gadol, vehahoreg kohen gadol, vechohen gadol sheharag – eno yotze mishsham leolam.

Veeno yotze lo leedut mitzva, velo leedut mamon, velo leedut nefashot. vaafillu yisrael tzerichim lo, vaafillu sar tzava yisrael keyoav ben tzeruya eno yotze mishsham leolam, shenneemar: "asher nas shamma" – sham tehe dirato, sham tehe mitato, sham tehe kevurato.

Keshem shehair koletet – kach techumah kolet. rotzeach sheyyetze chutz lattechum umetzao goel haddam, rabbi yose haggelili omer: mitzva beyad goel haddam, ureshut beyad kol adam. rabbi akiva omer: reshut beyad goel haddam, vechol adam chayyayvin alav.

Gemara may tama? amar abbaye: kal vachomer, uma mi sheggala kevar – yatza achshav, mi shello gala – eno din shello yigle? vedilma: hay digla ikkappar leh, hay dela gela la! midde galut ka mechappera? mitat kohen hu dimchappera!

Im ad shello nigmar dino vechulei. mena hane mille? amar rav kahana: deamar kera: "veyashav bah ad mot hakkohen haggadol asher mashach oto beshemen hakkodesh", vechi hu moshcho? ella: ze shennimshach beyamav.
May hava leh lemebad? haya lo levakkesh rachamim sheyyigmor dino lizchut, velo bikkesh.

Amar abbaye: naktinan: nigmar dino vamet – molichin et atzmotav lesham, dichtiv: "lashuv lashevet baaretz ad mot hakkohen", veezehu yeshiva shehi baaretz – heve omer zo kevura. tana: met kodem shemmet kohen gadol, molichin atzmotav al kivre avotav, dichtiv: "yashuv harotzeach el eretz achuzzato", ezehu yeshiva shehi beeretz achuzzato heve omer zo kevura.
Nigmar dino, venaasa kohen ben gerusha o ben chalutza, peligi ba rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha. chad omer: meta kehunna. vechad omer: batla kehunna.

Lema biflugeta derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua ka mippalgi. ditnan: haya omed umakriv al gabbe hammizbeach, venoda shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza, rabbi eliezer omer: kol korbanot shehikriv pesulin, verabbi yehoshua machshir.
Man deamar meta kerabbi yehoshua, uman deamar batla kerabbi eliezer?

a: Allibba derabbi eliezer kulle alma la feligi, ki peligi allibba derabbi yehoshua: man deamar meta – kerabbi yehoshua, uman deamar batla – ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam dichtiv: "barech Adonai chelo ufoal yadav tirtze" – afillu chalalin shebbo, aval hacha, afillu rabbi yehoshua mode.
Nigmar dino vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar rav: shete taiyyot taa yoav beotah shaa, dichtiv: "vayyanos yoav el ohel Adonai vayyachazek bekarnot hammizbeach",

Taa – sheeno kolet ella gaggo, vehu tafas bekarnotav. taa – sheeno kolet ella mizbach bet olamim, vehu tafas mizbeach shel shilo. abbaye omer: beha name mita tea: taa – sheeno kolet ella kohen vaavoda beyado, vehu zar haya.

Amar resh lakish: shalosh taiyyot atid saro shel romi litot, dichtiv: "mi ze ba meedom chamutz begadim mibbotzra", toe – sheenah koletet ella betzer, vehu gole levotzra. toe – sheenah koletet ella shogeg, vehu mezid haya. toe – sheenah koletet ella adam, vehu malach hu.

Amar rabbi avahu: are miklat lo nittenu likvura, dichtiv: "umigreshehem yihyu livhemtam velirchusham ulechol chayyatam" – lechayyim nittenu velo likvura. metivi, "shamma" – sham tehe dirato, sham tehe mitato, sham tehe kevurato! rotzeach shane, degalli beh rachamana.
Keshem shehair koletet vechulei. ureminhu: "veyashav bah" – bah velo bitchumah! amar abbaye: la kashya, kan – liklot, kan – ladur.
"Ladur"? tippok leh deen osin sade migrash velo migrash sade, lo migrash ir velo ir migrash. amar rav sheshet: lo nitzrecha ella limchillot.

Rotzeach sheyyatza chutz lattechum vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "veratzach goel haddam et harotzeach" – mitzva beyad goel haddam, en goel haddam – reshut beyad kol adam, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: reshut beyad goel haddam, vechol adam chayyayvin alav.
May tama derabbi yose haggelili? mi ketiv: "im rotzeach"? verabbi akiva: mi ketiv: "yirtzach"?
Amar mar zutera bar toviyya amar rav: rotzeach sheyyetze chutz lattechum, umetzao goel haddam vaharago – neherag alav. keman? la kerabbi yose haggelili, vela kerabbi akiva!

Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer: "ad omdo lifne haeda lammishpat", ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar: "veratzach goel haddam et harotzeach", yachol miyyad? talmud lomar: "ad omdo lifne haeda lammishpat".

Verabbi yose verabbi akiva, hay "ad omdo lifne haeda lammishpat" may darshi beh? hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya, rabbi akiva omer: minnayin lesanhedrin sherau echad sheharag et hannefesh sheen memitin oto ad sheyyaamod bevet din acher? talmud lomar: "ad omdo lifne haeda lammishpat" – ad sheyyaamod bevet din acher.
Tanu rabbanan: "im yatzo yetze harotzeach" – en li ella bemezid, beshogeg minnayin? talmud lomar: "im yatzo yetze" – mikkol makom.
Vehatanya: vehahorgo, bemezid – neherag, beshogeg – gole! la kashya, ha keman deamar: amrinan dibbera tora chilshon bene adam, ha keman deamar: la amrinan dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.

Amar abbaye: mistabbera keman deamar dibbera tora kilshon bene adam, shello yehe sofo chamur mittechillato: ma techillato, bemezid – neherag, beshogeg – gole, af sofo, bemezid – neherag, beshogeg – gole.
Tane chada: av sheharag – beno naasa lo goel haddam. vetanya iddach: en beno naasa lo goel haddam. lema ha rabbi yose haggelili veha rabbi akiva?

Vetisbera? ben leman deamar mitzva ben leman deamar reshut, mi shere? vehaamar rabba bar rav huna, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: lakkol en habben naase shaliach leaviv lehakkoto ulekillato, chutz mimmesit, shehare amra tora "lo tachmol velo techasse alav"!
Ella la kashya: ha bivno, veha beven beno.
Mishna ilan shehu omed betoch hattechum, venofo note chutz lattechum, o omed chutz lattechum venofo note betoch hattechum – hakkol holech achar hannof.
Gemara ureminhi: ilan shehu omed betoch happanim venote lachutz, o omed bachutz venote lifnim, mikkeneged hachoma velifnim – kelifnim, mikkeneged hachoma velachutz – kelachutz!
Maaser aare miklat ka ramet? maaser bechoma tela rachamana, are miklat bedira tela rachamana – benofo mittedar leh, beikkaro la mittedar leh.
Uremi maaser ammaaser, detanya: birushalayim – hallech achar hannof, beare miklat – hallech achar hannof. amar rav kahana: la kashya, ha rabbi yehuda veha rabbanan, detanya,
b: Rabbi yehuda omer: bimara – hallech achar pitchah, beilan – hallech achar nofo.

Emor deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda gabbe maaser lechumera, ikkaro bachutz venofo bifnim, ki hechi divnofo la matze parek – beikkaro name la matze parek. ikkaro mibbifnim venofo mibbachutz, ki hechi divnofo la matze achel belo pediyyay – beikkaro name la matze achel belo pediyyay.

Ella gabbe are miklat, bishlama ikkaro bachutz venofo bifnim, ki hechi divnofo la matze katel leh, beikkaro name la matze katel leh. ella ikkaro bifnim venofo bachutz, ki hechi divnofo matze katel leh, beikkaro name matze katel leh?! ha gavvay kae!
Amar rava: beikkaro – dechulle alma la peligi dela matze katel. kae benofo, veyachol lehorgo bechitztzim uvitzrorot – dechulle alma la peligi dematze katel leh.
Ki peligi – bemeheve ikkaro darga lenofo. mar savar: have ikkaro darga lenofo. umar savar: la have ikkaro darga lenofo.
Rav ashe amar: may "achar hannof" – af achar hannof.
Mishna harag beotah hair – gole mishshechuna lishchuna, uven levi – gole meir leir.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vesamti lecha makom vegomer", "vesamti lecha" – bechayyecha. "makom mimmekomcha asher yanus shamma" – melammed shehayu yisrael maglin bammidbar. lehechan maglin – lemachane leviyya.
Mikkan amru: ben levi sheharag – gole mippelech lefelech, veim gala lefilko – pilko kolto. amar rav acha bereh derav ika: may kera? "ki veir miklato yeshev" – ir shekkelatattu kevar.
Mishna kayyotze bo, rotzeach sheggala lair miklato veratzu anshe hair lechabbedo, yomar lahem "rotzeach ani", amru lo: "af al pi chen" – yekabbel mehen, shenneemar: "veze devar harotzeach".

a: Maalim hayu sachar lalviyyim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: lo hayu maalim lahen sachar. vechozer lisrara shehaya bah, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: lo haya chozer lisrara shehaya bah.
Gemara amar rav kahana: machaloket beshesh, demar savar "lachem" – liklita. umar savar: "lachem" – lechol tzorchechem. aval bearbaim ushetayim – divre hakkol hayu maalin lahem sachar.

Amar leh rava: ha vadday "lachem" – lechol tzorchechem mashma. ella amar rava: machaloket bearbaim ushetayim, demar savar: "vaalehem tittenu" – ki hanach liklita. umar savar: "vaalehem tittenu" – ki hanach, ma hanach lechol tzorchechem, af hane name – lechol tzorchechem, aval beshesh – divre hakkol lo hayu maalim lahen sachar.

Chozer lisrara shehaya bah kulei. tanu rabbanan: "veshav el mishpachto veel achuzzat avotav yashuv" – lemishpachto hu shav, veeno shav lema shehechziku avotav, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: af hu shav lema shehechziku avotav, "el achuzzat avotav" – kaavotav.
Vechen baggola, keshehu omer "yashuv" – lerabbot et harotzeach.

May "vechen baggola"? kidtanya: "yashuv harotzeach el eretz achuzzato" – leeretz achuzzato hu shav, veeno shav lema shehechziku avotav, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: af hu shav lema shehechziku avotav – gamar shiva shiva mehatam.
Hadaran alach ellu hen haggolin

Mishna ellu hen hallokin: habba al achoto, veal achot aviv, veal achot immo, veal achot ishto, veal eshet achiv, veal eshet achi aviv, veal hannidda. almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lenatin ulemamzer.
Almana ugerusha – chayyayvin aleha mishshum shene shemot. gerusha vachalutza – eno chayyayv ella mishshum achat bilvad.
Hattame sheachal et hakkodesh, vehabba el hammikdash tame, veochel chelev, vadam venotar ufiggul vetame.

Vehashshochet umaale bachutz, vehaochel chametz befesach, vehaochel vehaose melacha beyom hakkippurim, vehamefattem et hashshemen, vehamefattem et hakketoret, vehassach beshemen hammishcha, vehaochel nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim.
Achal tevel umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu.

Kamma yochal min hattevel vihe chayyayv? rabbi shimon omer: kol shehu. vachachamim omrim: kezayit. amar lahen rabbi shimon: i attem modim li beochel nemala kol shehu shehu chayyayv? amru lo: mippene shehi kivriyyaytah. amar lahen: af chitta achat kivriyyaytah.
Gemara chayyayve charetot ka tane, chayyayve mitot bet din la katane. matnitin manni – rabbi akiva hi, detanya: echad chayyayve charetot veechad chayyayve mitot bet din
b: [Yeshnan] bichlal malkot arbaim, divre rabbi yishmael.

Rabbi akiva omer: chayyayve charetot (yeshno) [yeshnan] bichlal malkot arbaim, sheim asu teshuva bet din shel mala mochalin lahen. chayyayve mitot bet din eno bichlal malkot arbaim, sheim asu teshuva en bet din shel matta mochalin lahen.
Rabbi yitzchak omer: chayyayve charetot bakkelal hayu, velamma yatzat karet baachoto – leduno becharet velo bemalkot.

May tama derabbi yishmael? dichtiv: "im lo tishmor laasot et kol divre hattora hazzot", uchetiv: "vehifla Adonai et makkotcha". hafelaa zo eni yodea ma hi. keshehu omer: "vehippilo hashshofet vehikkahu lefanav", heve omer hafelaa zo malkot hi, uchetiv: "im lo tishmor laasot et kol vegomer".
I hachi, chayyayve ase name! "im lo tishmor" ketiv, vechidrabbi avin amar rabbi ilay, deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ilay: kol makom shenneemar "hishshamer" "pen" veal" – eno ella lo taase.
I hachi, lav sheen bo maase name! "laasot" ketiv.
Lav shennittak laase name! duvmya delav dachasima.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, kullehu name dumeya delav dachasima.
Verabbi akiva may tama? "kede rishato" – mishshum risha achat atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum shete rishayot.
Verabbi yishmael: hane mille mita umamon, o malkot umamon, aval mita umalkot – mita arichta hi.
Ulerabbi akiva, i hachi chayyayve charetot name! may amrat, sheim asu teshuva? hasheta mihat la avdi!
Amar rabbi avahu: beferush ribbeta tora chayyayve charetot lemalkut, digmar "leene" milleenecha". matkef la rabbi abba bar memel: i hachi chayyayve mitot bet din name, nigmar "meene" milleenecha"!
Danin "leene" milleenecha", veen danin "meene" milleenecha".
Umay nafka minneh? veha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshav hakkohen", "uva hakkohen", zo hi shiva vezo hi bia!
Veod: ligmar "meene" milleene", deha gamar "leene" milleenecha"!
Kabbela minneh rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: "kede rishato" – mishshum risha achat atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum shete rishayot – berisha hammesura levet din hakkatuv medabber.

Rava amar: atro beh liktala – kulle alma la peligi deen loke vamet. ki peligi – deatro beh lemalkut, rabbi yishmael savar: lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din – lokin alav. verabbi akiva savar: lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din – en lokin alav.

Verabbi akiva, i hachi chayyayve charetot name, lav shennittan leazharat karet hu! amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: hachi amar avimi mehageronya mishshemeh derava: chayyayve charetot la tzerichi hateraa, shehare pesach umila anash af al pi shello hizhir.
Vedilma azhara lekorban. deha pesach umila delet behu azhara la mayyte korban!
Hatam lav hayeynu tama, ella mishshum deittakkash kol hattora kullah laavoda zara: ma avoda zara – shev veal taase, af kol – shev veal taase, leappoke hane dekum ase.
Ravina amar: leolam

a: Kidamrinan meikkara, sheim asu teshuva – bet din shel mala mochalin lahen. may amrat? ha la avud teshuva? la pesika milleta lecharet.
Rabbi yitzchak omer: chayyayve charetot bakkelal hayu, velamma yatzat karet baachoto – leduno becharet velo bemalkot.
