Verabbanan, karet baachoto lema li? lechallek, vechidrabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: sheim asaan kullam behelem echad – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Verabbi yitzchak, lechallek mena leh? nafka leh mivveel ishsha beniddat tumatah, lechayyev al kol ishsha veishsha.
Verabbanan name, tippok leh meha! in hachi name. veella, karet daachoto lema li? lechayyeyvo al achoto veal achot aviv veal achot immo.
Peshita, hare gufin muchelakin, hare shemot muchelakin! ella, lechayyeyvo al achoto shehi achot aviv shehi achot immo. vehechi mashkachat la – berashshia bar rashshia.

Verabbi yitzchak, ha mena leh? nafka leh mikkal vachomer, detanya: amar rabbi akiva: shaalti et rabban gamliel verabbi yehoshua baitliz shel emaum, shehalchu likkach behema lemishte veno shel rabban gamliel: habba al achoto shehi achot aviv shehi achot immo, mahu? [eno] chayyayv al kullan ella achat, o chayyayv al kol achat veachat?

Amru lo: zo lo shamanu, aval shamanu: habba al chamesh nashim niddot behelem echad, shechayyayv al kol achat veachat, venirin devarim mikkal vachomer: uma nidda shehi shem echad – chayyayv al kol achat veachat, kan sheshshelosha shemot – lo kol shekken?
Veiddach, kal vachomer pericha hu: ma lenidda, shekken gufin muchelakin.
Uleiddach name, hay vadday kal vachomer pericha hu! ella, nafka leh meachoto" desefa.
Veiddach, "achoto" desefa lema li? lechayyeyvo al achoto bat aviv uvat immo, lomar sheen onshin min haddin.
Veiddach? ibbaet ema gamar onesh meazhara. veibbaet ema, nafka leh
b: Meachoto" deresha.
Veiddach: hahu mibbee leh, lechallek karet lamfattem velassach.
Veiddach? savar kerabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya, deamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya: kol makom sheatta motze shene lavin vecharet echad – chalukin hen lekorban.
Vei baet ema: la savar la kerabbi elazar, venafka leh mivish asher yishkav et ishsha dava".

Veiddach? hahu mibbee leh lechidrabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: minnayin sheen haishsha temea ad sheyyetze madveha derech ervatah? shenneemar: "veish asher yishkav et ishsha dava vegilla et ervatah vegomer" – melammed sheen haishsha temea ad sheyyetze madveha derech ervatah.

"Vetame sheachal et hakkodesh". bishlama habba lammikdash tame – ketiv onesh uchetiv azhara: onesh – dichtiv: "et mishkan Adonai timme venichreta". azhara – "velo yetammeu et machanehem". ella tame sheachal et hakkodesh, bishlama "onesh" ketiv – "vehannefesh asher tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim asher laAdonai vetumato alav venichreta", ella azhara minnayin?
Resh lakish omer: "bechol kodesh lo tigga".
Rabbi yochanan omer, tane bardela: atya "tumeato" "tumeato", ketiv hacha "vetumato alav venichreta", uchetiv hatam "tame yihye od tumato bo", ma lehallan onesh veazhara – af kan onesh veazhara.
Bishlama, resh lakish la amar kerabbi yochanan – gezera shava la gemir. ella rabbi yochanan, may tama la amar keresh lakish? amar lach: hahu azhara litruma.
Veresh lakish, azhara litruma mena leh? nafka leh meish ish mizzera aharon vehu tzarua o zav", e zehu davar shehu shave bezaro shel aharon – heve omer zo teruma. veiddach? hahu laachila, veha lingia.

Veresh lakish, hay "bechol kodesh lo tigga" lehachi hu daata? hahu mibbee leh letame shennaga bakkodesh! deittemar: tame shennaga bakkodesh, resh lakish omer: loke, rabbi yochanan omer: eno loke. resh lakish omer: loke, "bechol kodesh lo tigga". rabbi yochanan omer: en loke, hahu azhara litruma hu daata!
Tame shennaga bakkodesh – middeappekeh rachamana bilshon negia, azhara laochel – ittakkavsh kodesh lemikdash.

Veakkatti, lehachi hu daata? hahu mibbee leh letame sheachal besar kodesh lifne zerikat damim! deittemar: tame sheachal besar kodesh lifne zerikat damim, resh lakish omer: loke, rabbi yochanan omer: eno loke.

Resh lakish omer: loke, "bechol kodesh lo tigga", la shena lifne zerika vela shena leachar zerika. rabbi yochanan omer: eno loke. rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar kera "tumeato" "tumeato", vechi ketiv "tumeato" – leachar zerika hu dichtiv! hahi mibbechol kodesh" nafka.

Tanya kevoteh deresh lakish: "bechol kodesh lo tigga" – azhara laochel. atta omer azhara laochel, o eno ella azhara lannogea? talmud lomar: bechol kodesh lo tigga veel hammikdash vegomer" – makkish kodesh lammikdash, ma mikdash davar sheyyesh bo netilat neshama – af kol davar sheyyesh bo netilat neshama. vei bingia – mi ikka netilat neshama? ella baachila.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol lo taase shekkedamo ase – lokin alav.

a: Amru lo: amarta? amar lehu: la. amar rabba: haelohim! amra, uchetiva utenena: ketiva – "vishallechu min hammachane [vegomer]" "velo yetammeu et machanehem". tenena – habba lammikdash tame.
Ella may tama ka hadar beh? mishshum dekashya leh ones. detanya: ones sheggerash, im yisrael hu – machzir veeno loke. im kohen hu – loke veeno machzir.
Im yisrael hu – machzir veeno loke, ammay? lo taase shekkedamo ase hu, velilke!
Amar ulla: lo yeamer "lo tihye leishsha", beones, veligmar mimmotzi shem ra: uma motzi shem ra shello asa maase – amar rachamana "velo tihye leishsha", ones lo kol shekken?
Lamma neemar? im eno inyan lefanav tenehu inyan leacharav, sheim gerash yachazir.
Veakkatti, ones mimmotzi shem ra la gamar, deikka lemifrach: ma lemotzi shem ra, shekken loke umeshallem!

Ella: lo yeamer "lo tihye leishsha" bemotzi shem ra, veligmar meones: uma ones sheeno loke umeshallem, amar rachamana "velo tihye leishsha", motzi shem ra lo kol shekken? velamma neemar? im eno inyan lammotzi shem ra – tenehu inyan laones, im eno inyan lefanav – tenehu inyan leacharav.
Umotzi shem ra meones name la gamar, deikka lemifrach: ma leones – shekken asa maase!
Ella: lo yeamer "lo tihye leishsha" bemotzi shem ra, shehare ishto hi. lamma neemar? im eno inyan lammotzi shem ra – tenehu inyan laones, veim eno inyan lefanav – tenehu inyan leacharav.
Veema, veim eno inyan lefanav demotzi shem ra – tenehu inyan leacharav dideh, dela lake!
In hachi name, veate ones vegamar minneh. bemay gamar minneh? i bekal vachomer i bema matzinu" – ikka lemifrach kidfarchinan: ma lemotzi shem ra, shekken lo asa maase!
Ella amar rava: kol yamav baamod vehachezer. vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: kol yamav baamod vehachezer.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: veha la dame laveh lelav dachasima! amar leh: mishshum dichtav beh rachamana ase yattira migra gara?
I hachi, lav shennittak laase name, lema: mishshum dichtav beh rachamana ase yattira migra gara? amar leh: hahu lenattoke lav hu daata.
Hanicha leman deamar bittelo velo bittelo,
Ella leman deamar kiyyeymo velo kiyyeymo, may ikka lememar?
b: Midde hu tama ella lerabbi yochanan? haamar leh rabbi yochanan letanna, teni: bittelo – chayyayv, velo bittelo – patur.
Detane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan: kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase, kiyyem ase shebbah – patur, bittel ase shebbah – chayyayv.
Amar leh: may ka amrat? kiyyem – patur, lo kiyyem – chayyayv, bittel – chayyayv, lo bittel – patur! teni: bittelo velo bittelo. verabbi shimon ben lakish omer: kiyyeymo velo kiyyeymo.
Bemay ka mippalgi? behateraat safek ka mippalgi, mar savar: hateraat safek shemah hateraa,
Umar savar: hateraat safek lo shemah hateraa.
Veazdu letamayyhu, deittemar: "shevua sheochal kikkar ze hayyom", veavar hayyom velo achalah, rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: eno loke. rabbi yochanan omer: eno loke,

a: Mishshum dehave lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase – en lokin alav. resh lakish omer: eno loke, mishshum dehave hateraat safek, vechol hateraat safek – lo shemah hateraa.

Vetarvayyhu allibba derabbi yehuda. detanya: "velo totiru mimmennu ad boker, vehannotar mimmennu ad boker vegomer", ba hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase, lomar sheen lokin alav, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yochanan dayek hachi: tama deva hakkatuv, ha lo ba hakkatuv – loke, alma: hateraat safek shemah hateraa.
Veresh lakish dayek hachi: tama deva hakkatuv, ha lo ba hakkatuv – loke, alma: lav sheen bo maase lokin alav.
Verabbi shimon ben lakish name, ha vadday hateraat safek hu!

Savar la keiddach tanna derabbi yehuda. detanya: hikka ze vechazar vehikka ze, killel ze vechazar vekillel ze, hikka shenehem bevat achat o killel shenehem bevat achat – chayyayv. rabbi yehuda omer: bevat achat – chayyayv, beze achar ze – patur.
Verabbi yochanan name, ha vadday lav sheen bo maase hu!

Savar la ki ha deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav amram amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili: kol lo taase shebbattora, lav sheyyesh bo maase – lokin alav, lav sheen bo maase – en lokin alav, chutz min hannishba, umemir, vehamekallel et chavero bashshem.
Kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda!
I lerabbi shimon ben lakish – tere tannae allibba derabbi yehuda, i lerabbi yochanan – la kashya: ha dideh, ha derabbeh.

Tenan hatam: hannotel em al habbanim, rabbi yehuda omer: loke, veeno meshalleach. vachachamim omrim: meshalleach veeno loke. ze hakkelal: kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase – en chayyayvin aleha. amar rabbi yochanan: en lanu ella zot veod acheret.
Amar leh rabbi elazar: hecha? amar leh: lechi tashkach. nefak dak veashkach, detanya: ones sheggerash, im yisrael hu – machzir veeno loke, veim kohen hu – loke veeno machzir.
Hanicha leman detane kiyyeymo velo kiyyeymo.
Ella leman detane bittelo velo bittelo, bishlama gabbe shilluach hakken mashkachat la, ella ones bittelo velo bittelo hechi mashkachat la?

I dekatla – kam leh bidrabba minneh! amar rav shimi machoznaa: kegon shekkibbel lah kiddushin meacher. amar rav: i shavvevyteh shaliach – ihi ka mevattela leh, i la shavvevyteh shaliach – kol keminneh? vela kelum hi!

Ella amar rav shimi minnehardea kegon shehiddirah barabbim. hanicha leman deamar neder shehuddar barabbim en lo hafara, ella leman deamar yesh lo hafara, may ikka lememar? (demaddira la) [kegon shehiddirah] al daat rabbim. deamar ammemar: hilcheta, neder shehuddar barabbim – yesh lo hafara, al daat rabbim – en lo hafara.

Vetu lekka? veha ikka (siman gazel mashkon ufea), gazel, derachamana amar "lo tigzol", "veheshiv et haggezela". mashkon, derachamana amar "lo tavo el beto laavot avoto", "hashev tashiv lo haavot kevo hashshemesh".
Umashkachat la bekiyyeymo velo kiyyeymo, uvittelo velo bittelo! hatam kevan dechayyayv betashlumin – en loke umeshallem.
Matkef la rabbi zera: ha ikka mashkono shel ger, umet hagger!
b: Hatam, gavra bar tashlumin hu, veshibuda deger hu deka faka.
Veha ikka pea, derachamana amar "lo techalle peat vegomer" "leani velagger taazov otam vegomer",

Demashkachat la bekiyyeymo velo kiyyeymo, bittelo velo bittelo! ditnan: mitzvat pea lehaferish min hakkama. lo hifrish min hakkama – mafrish min haomarin. lo hifrish min haomarin – mafrish min hakkeri, ad shello merach. mercho – measser venoten lo!
Kidrabbi yishmael, deamar: af mafrish min haissa. ulerabbi yishmael name mashkachat la, daachal issa!
Ella, "zot veod acheret" – aha, aval ones – la. dehecha amrinan al daat rabbim en lo hafara – lidvar harshut, aval lidvar mitzva – yesh lo hafara.
Ki ha dehahu makre dardeke dahava pasha beyanoke, addereh rav acha, veahdereh ravina, dela ishtechach dedayek kevoteh.

Vehaochel nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim vechulei. amar rav yehuda: hay man daachal binita deve cherava – malkinan leh mishshum "sheretz hashshoretz al haaretz". hahu daachal binita deve cherava venaggedeh rav yehuda.
Amar abbaye: achal putita – loke arbaa.
Nemala – loke chamesh, mishshum "sheretz hashshoretz al haaretz".
Tzira – loke shesh, mishshum sheretz haof.
Amar rav achay: hameshahe et nekavav over mishshum "lo teshakketzu". amar rav bivi bar abbaye: hay man deshate bekarna deummana ka avar mishshum "lo teshakketzu".

Amar rava bar rav huna: rissek tisha nemalim vehevi echad chay vehishliman lichzayit – loke shesh, chamesh – mishshum beriyya, veechad – mishshum kezayit nevela. rava amar rabbi yochanan: afillu shenayim vehu. rav yosef amar: afillu achad vehu. vela peligi, ha – beravreve, veha – bezutere.
"Achal tevel umaaser rishon" kulei. amar rav: achal tevel shel masar ani – loke.

Keman – ki hay tanna, detanya, amar rabbi yose: yachol lo yehe chayyayv ella al hattevel shello huram mimmennu kol ikkar; huram mimmennu teruma gedola velo huram mimmennu maaser rishon, maaser rishon velo maaser sheni, vaafillu masar ani, minnayin?
Talmud lomar: "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha vegomer" ulehallan hu omer: "veachlu visharecha vesaveu", ma lehallan masar ani, af kan masar ani, veamar rachamana: "lo tuchal".
Amar rav yosef: ketannae, rabbi eliezer omer: en tzarich likrot et hashshem al masar ani shel demay, vachachamim omrim:

a: Kore et hashshem, veeno tzarich lehaferish.
May lav beha ka mippalgi, demar savar: vadday – tovlo. umar savar: vadday – eno tovlo? amar leh abbaye: i hachi, addemippalgi bisfeko, lippalgu bevadday!

Ella, dechulle alma vadday – tovlo. vehacha beha ka mippalgi, mar savar: lo nechshedu amme haaretz al masar ani shel demay. kevan demamona hu – afroshe mafresh. verabbanan savri: kevan ditricha leh milleta – la mafresh.

Kamma yochal min hattevel vechulei: amar rav bivi amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: machloket bechitta, aval bekemach – divre hakkol kezayit. verabbi yirmeya amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo.
Tenan, amar lahem rabbi shimon: i attem modim li beochel nemala kol shehu shehu chayyayv? amru lo: mippene shehi kivriyyaytah. amar lahen: af chitta achat kivriyyaytah. chitta – in, kemach – la!

Ledivrehem kaamar lehu: ledidi – afillu kemach name, ella ledidchu – odo li mihat dechitta achat kivriyyaytah. verabbanan: beriyyayt neshama – chashivva, chitta – la chashivva. tanya kevateh derabbi yirmeya, rabbi shimon omer: kol shehu lemakkot, lo amru kezayit ella leinyan korban.

Mishna haochel bikkurim ad shello kara alehem, kodshe kadashim chutz lakkelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni chutz lachoma. hashshover et haetzem bappesach hattahor – hare ze loke arbaim. aval hammotir battahor vehashshover battame – eno loke arbaim.
Hannotel em al habbanim, rabbi yehuda omer: loke veeno meshalleach. vachachamim omrim: meshalleach veeno loke. ze hakkelal: kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase – en chayyayvin aleha.
Gemara amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi akiva setimtaa, aval chachamim omrim: bikkurim – hannacha meakkevet bahen, keria en meakkevet bahen.
Velema zo divre rabbi shimon setimtaa! ha ka mashma lan derabbi akiva kerabbi shimon sevira leh.
May rabbi shimon? detanya: "uterumat yadecha" – ellu bikkurim.

Amar rabbi shimon: ma ba ze lelammedenu? im leochlan chutz lachoma – kal vachomer mimmaaser hakkal: uma maaser hakkal, ochlan chutz lachoma loke – bikkurim lo kol shekken? ha lo ba hakkatuv ella laochel mibbikkurim ad shello kara alehem, shehu loke.

"Venidvotecha" – zo toda ushelamim. amar rabbi shimon: ma ba ze lelammedenu? im leochlan chutz lachoma – kal vachomer mimmaaser, ha lo ba hakkatuv ella laochel betoda uvishlamim lifne zerika, shehu loke.

"Uvechorot" – ze habbechor. amar rabbi shimon: ma ba ze lelammedenu? im leochlan chutz lachoma – kal vachomer mimmaaser, im lifne zerika – kal vachomer mittoda ushelamim! ha lo ba hakkatuv ella laochel min habbechor afillu leachar zerika, shehu loke.
"Bekarcha vetzonecha" – zo chattat veasham. amar rabbi shimon: ma ba ze lelammedenu?

Im leochlan chutz lachoma – kal vachomer mimmaaser, im lifne zerika – kal vachomer mittoda ushelamim, im leachar zerika – kal vachomer mibbechor! ha lo ba hakkatuv ella laochel mechattat veasham afillu leachar zerika chutz lakkelaim, shehu loke.
"Nedarecha" – zo ola. amar rabbi shimon: ma ba ze lelammedenu?

Im leochlan chutz lachoma – kal vachomer mimmaaser, im lifne zerika – kal vachomer mittoda ushelamim, im leachar zerika – kal vachomer mibbechor, im chutz lakkelaim – kal vachomer mechattat veasham! ha lo ba hakkatuv
b: Ella laochel min haola leachar zerika, afillu bifnim, shehu loke.
Amar rava: deyalyda immeh kerabbi shimon – telid, vei la – la telid. veaf al gav deit lehu pircha.
May chumera devikkurim mimmaaser – shekken asurim lezarim. adderabba, maaser chamur, shekken asur leonen.
Umay chumera detoda ushelamim mimmaaser – shekken teunin mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach. adderabba, maaser chamur, shekken teunin kesef tzura.
Umay chumera divchor mittoda ushelamim – shekken kedushshato merechem. adderabba: toda ushelamim chamurim, shekken teunim semicha, unesachim, utenufat chaze vashok.
Umay chumera dechattat veasham mibbechor – shekken kodshe kadashim. adderabba, bechor chamur, shekken kedushshato merechem.
Umay chumera deola mechattat veasham – shekken kalil. adderabba, chattat veasham chamiri, shekken mechapperi.
Vechullehu chamiri meola, deit behu shete achilot!
Ella may deyalyda immeh kerabbi shimon? dilmay disvira leh ledideh, mesares leh likra vedaresh leh.
Vechi mazhirin min haddin? ha afillu leman deamar onshin min haddin, en mazhirin min haddin! issura bealma.
Vehaamar rava: zar sheachal min haola lifne zerika chutz lachoma, lerabbi shimon loke chamesh! chamishsha issurin havu.
Veha anan tenan: ellu hen hallokin!

a: Ella kera yattira hu, mikkede ketiv "veheveta sham veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha bammakom vegomer", lichtov rachamana "lo tuchal leochlam", mihdar mefaresh behu rachamana lema li?
Ella leyachode lehu lave lechol chad vechad.

Gufa, amar rava: zar sheachal min haola lifne zerika chutz lachoma – lerabbi shimon loke chamesh. velilke name mishshum: "vezar lo yochal ki kodesh hem"! hane mille hecha dilchohanim chaze, hacha dilchohanim name la chaze.
Velilke name mishshum "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu", kevan sheyyatza basar chutz limchitzato – neesar! hane mille hecha devifnim chaze, hacha divfanim name la chaze.
Velilke name kidrabbi eliezer, deamar rabbi eliezer: "lo yeachel ki kodesh hu",
b: Kol shebbakkodesh pasul – ba hakkatuv litten lo taase al achilato! hane mille hecha dekodem pesulo chaze, hacha dekodem pesulo name la chaze.
Velilke name keiddach derabbi eliezer. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: kol shehu bechalil tihye" – litten lo taase al achilato! in hachi name, verava – mehay kera kaamar.

Amar rav giddel amar rav: (siman kuza) kohen sheachal mechattat veasham lifne zerika – loke. may tama? deamar kera: "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem", leachar kappara – in, lifne kappara – la. lav habba mikkelal ase, – lav hu.
Metiv rava: "vechol behema mafreset parsa veshosaat shesa shete ferasot maalat gera babbehema otah tochelu", "otah tochelu" – veen behema acheret tochelu. vei kidkaamrat, "et ze lo tochlu" lema li?

Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar, amar rav giddel amar rav: zar sheachal mechattat veasham lifne zerika – patur, may tama – deamar kera: "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem", kol hecha dekarenan beh "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem" – karenan beh "vezar lo yochal kodesh", vechol hecha dela karenan beh "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem" – la karenan beh "vezar lo yochal".
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya: bikkurim, hannacha meakkevet bahen, keriyyay en meakkevet bahen.

Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi? veha amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya: hifrish bikkurim kodem lechag, veavar alehen hechag – yerakvu. may lav mishshum dela matze lemikre alehen? vei salka datach keriyyay en meakkevet bahen, ammay yerakvu?
Kidrabbi zera. deamar rabbi zera: kol harauy levilla – en billa meakkevet bo, vechol sheeno rauy levilla – billa meakkevet bo.

Rabbi acha bar yaakov matne la kidrabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan, vekashya leh derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan. umi amar rabbi yochanan bikkurim hannacha meakkevet bahen keriyyay en meakkevet bahen? veha bea minneh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan: bikkurim meematay muttarin lechohanim? vaamar leh: haruyin likriyyay – mishshekkara alehen, vesheen reuyin likriyyay – mishsherau pene habbayit.
Kashya keriyyay akkeriyyay, kashya hannacha ahannacha!
Keriyyay akkeriyya la kashya: ha rabbi shimon, ha rabbanan. hannacha ahannacha name la kashya: ha rabbi yehuda, veha rabbanan.

May rabbi yehuda? detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: "vehinnachto" – zo tenufa. atta omer zo tenufa, o eno ella hannacha mammash? keshehu omer "vehinnicho" – hare hannacha amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "vehinnachto" – zo tenufa.

Uman tanna diflig aleh derabbi yehuda? rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi, detanya: "velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha" – limmed al habbikkurim shetteunin tenufa, divre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov. may tama derabbi eliezer ben yaakov?

Atya "yad" "yad" mishshelamim: ketiv hacha "velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha", uchetiv "yadav teviena et ishshe Adonai", ma kan kohen – af lehallan kohen, ma lehallan bealim – af kan bealim. ha ketzad? manniach kohen yadav tachat yede bealim umenif.
Amar rava bar adda amar rabbi yitzchak: bikkurim

a: Meematay (40)chayyayvin alehem – mishsheyyiru pene habbayit. keman – ki hay tanna, detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: bikkurim miktzatan bachutz umiktzatan bifnim, shebbachutz – hare hen kechullin lechol divrehem, shebbifnim – hare hen kehekdesh lechol divrehem.
Amar rav sheshet: bikkurim, hannacha – meakkevet bahen, keriyyay – en meakkevet bahen.

Keman – ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi yose omer shelosha devarim mishshum shelosha zekenim, rabbi yishmael omer: yachol yaale adam maaser sheni bizman hazze birushalayim, veyochlennu? vedin hu: bechor taun havaat makom, umaaser sheni taun havaat makom, ma bechor eno ella bifne habbayit – af maaser eno ella bifne habbayit.
Ma livchor shekken taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach! bikkurim yochichu. ma levikkurim, shekken teunim hannacha!

Talmud lomar: "veachalta [sham] lifne Adonai elohecha vegomer" – makkish maaser livchor, ma bechor eno ella lifne habbayit – af maaser eno ella lifne habbayit. veim ita, lifroch: ma levikkurim – shekken teunin keriyyay vehannacha!

Amar rav ashe: nehi deikkuva lekka, mitzva mi lekka? velema mitzva velifroch! ella amar rav ashe: kevan deikka bikkure hagger, devae lememar asher nishba [Adonai] laavotenu", vela matze amar – la pesika leh.
Velihdar dina vetete bamma hatztzad"! mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken yesh bahen tzad mizbeach.
Umay kasavar? i kasavar kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo – bechor name, i kasavar kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo – afillu bechor name tibbee!

Amar ravina: leolam kasavar kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo, vehacha bivchor shennizrak damo kodem chureban habbayit, vecharav habbayit vaadayin besaro kayyaym. umakkeshinan besaro ledamo, ma damo bammizbeach – af besaro bammizbeach. umakkish maaser livchor.
Vechi davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umelammed behekkesh? masar dagan chullin hu.
b: Hanicha leman deamar batar lamed azlinan, ella leman deamar batar melammed azlinan, may ikka lememar?
Dam uvasar chada milleta hi.

Kodshe kodashim vechulei. tenena chada zimna: maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu! amar rabbi yose bar chanina: sefa bemaaser sheni tahor vegavra tahor, deka achel chutz lachoma. resha bemaaser sheni tame vegavra tame, veka achel leh birushalayim.
Umenalan demichayyayv aleh mishshum tumea? detanya, rabbi shimon omer: "lo biarti mimmennu betame" – ben sheani tame vehu tahor, ben sheani tahor vehu tame. vehechan muzehar al achila eni yodea.
Tumeat hagguf – behedya ketiv: "nefesh asher tigga bo vetama ad haarev velo yochal min hakkodashim vegomer" ella: tumeat atzmo minnayin?
Dichtiv: "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha". ulehallan hu omer: "bisharecha tochlennu hattame vehattahor",
Vetanya deve rabbi yishmael: afillu tame vetahor ochlin bikara achat veen choshshin, vekaamar rachamana: haych tame dishray lach gabbe tahor hatam – hacha la techol.
Umena lan devar pediyyay hu?
Deamar rabbi elazar: minnayin lemaaser sheni shennitma sheppodin oto afillu birushalayim? talmud lomar: "ki lo tuchal seeto." – veen "seet" ella achila, shenneemar "vayyissa masot meet panav".
Amar rav bivi amar rav assi: minnayin lemaaser sheni tahor sheppodin oto afillu bifsia achat chutz lachoma? shenneemar: "ki lo tuchal seeto". hay mibbee leh lechidrabbi elazar!
Im ken, lema kera "lo tuchal leochlo", may "seeto"? veema kullo lehachi hu daata! im ken, lema kera "lo tuchal littelo", may "seeto"? shema minna tarte.
Yatev rav chanina verav hoshaya, veka mibbaya lehu: appitcha dirushalayim, mahu? peshita, hu bachutz umassao bifnim – kelatuhu mechitzot, hu bifnim umassao bachutz, mahu?
Tena lehu hahu sava bidve rabbi shimon ben yochay: "ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom" – mimmilluacha.
Bae rav pappa: naket leh bekanya, may? teku.

Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: maaser sheni meematay chayyayvin alav – mishsheraa pene hachoma. may tama? deamar kera "lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu (shana veshana)", uchetiv "(ki) lo tuchal leechol bisharecha", kol hecha dekarenan beh "lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu" – karenan beh "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha". vechol hecha dela karenan beh "lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu" – la karenan beh "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha".

Metivi, rabbi yose omer: kohen shealta beyado teena shel tevel, amar: teena zo, terumatah beuketzah, maaser rishon bitzfonah, umaaser sheni lidromah. vehi shenat maaser sheni vehu birushalayim, o masar ani vehu bigvulin, achalah –
